source.text: וַיְהִי֩ בִשְׁנַ֨ת הַתְּשִׁיעִ֜ית לְמָלְכ֗וֹ בַּחֹ֣דֶשׁ הָעֲשִׂירִי֮ בֶּעָשׂ֣וֹר לַחֹדֶשׁ֒ בָּ֠א נְבֻכַדְנֶאצַּ֨ר מֶֽלֶךְ־בָּבֶ֜ל ה֧וּא וְכָל־חֵיל֛וֹ עַל־יְרוּשָׁלִַ֖ם וַיִּ֣חַן עָלֶ֑יהָ וַיִּבְנ֥וּ עָלֶ֖יהָ דָּיֵ֥ק סָבִֽיב׃

records.literal_gloss: And it was in [the] year the ninth of his reigning, in the month the tenth, on [the] tenth of the month, came Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, he and all his army, against Jerusalem, and encamped against it, and they built against it siege-work all around.

en.L: And it came about in the ninth year of his reign, in the tenth month, on the tenth [day] of the month, [that] Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came, he and all his army, against Jerusalem, and he encamped against it; and they built a siege wall against it all around.
en.B: On the tenth day of the tenth month, in the ninth year of Zedekiah's reign, Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon advanced on Jerusalem with his whole army. He camped against the city, and they built siege works against it on every side.
en.R: In the ninth year that Zedekiah was king, on the tenth day of the tenth month, Nebuchadnezzar, the king of Babylon, marched against Jerusalem with his whole army. He set up camp around the city, and his soldiers built ramps and walls against it on every side.

es.L: Y sucedió en el año noveno de su reinado, en el mes décimo, a los diez [días] del mes, [que] vino Nabucodonosor, rey de Babilonia, él y todo su ejército, contra Jerusalén, y acampó contra ella; y construyeron contra ella un muro de asedio alrededor.
es.B: El día diez del mes décimo, en el noveno año del reinado de Sedequías, Nabucodonosor, rey de Babilonia, avanzó contra Jerusalén con todo su ejército. Acampó frente a la ciudad, y construyeron obras de asedio contra ella por todos lados.
es.R: En el noveno año del reinado de Sedequías, el día diez del mes décimo, Nabucodonosor, el rey de Babilonia, marchó contra Jerusalén con todo su ejército. Acampó alrededor de la ciudad, y sus soldados construyeron rampas y muros contra ella por todos lados.

fr.L: Et il arriva, la neuvième année de son règne, au dixième mois, le dix du mois, [que] Nabuchodonosor, roi de Babylone, vint, lui et toute son armée, contre Jérusalem ; il campa contre elle, et ils bâtirent contre elle un mur de siège tout autour.
fr.B: Le dix du dixième mois de la neuvième année du règne de Sédécias, Nabuchodonosor, roi de Babylone, marcha contre Jérusalem avec toute son armée. Il campa devant la ville, et l’on éleva contre elle des ouvrages de siège tout autour.
fr.R: La neuvième année du règne de Sédécias, le dix du dixième mois, Nabuchodonosor, le roi de Babylone, a attaqué Jérusalem avec toute son armée. Il a installé son camp autour de la ville, et ses soldats ont construit des rampes et des murs contre elle de tous les côtés.

sw.L: Ikawa katika mwaka wa tisa wa kutawala kwake, katika mwezi wa kumi, siku ya kumi ya mwezi, Nebukadneza mfalme wa Babeli akaja, yeye na jeshi lake lote, juu ya Yerusalemu, akapiga kambi juu yake; nao wakajenga boma la kuuzingira pande zote.
sw.B: Siku ya kumi ya mwezi wa kumi, katika mwaka wa tisa wa utawala wa Sedekia, Nebukadneza mfalme wa Babeli alikuja kuishambulia Yerusalemu pamoja na jeshi lake lote. Akapiga kambi kuukabili mji, nao wakajenga maboma ya kuuzingira pande zote.
sw.R: Katika mwaka wa tisa wa utawala wa Sedekia, siku ya kumi ya mwezi wa kumi, Nebukadneza, mfalme wa Babeli, alikuja kuishambulia Yerusalemu pamoja na jeshi lake lote. Akapiga kambi kuuzunguka mji, nao askari wake wakajenga maboma na kuta za kuushambulia pande zote.

vi.L: Xảy ra vào năm thứ chín đời trị vì của vua, tháng thứ mười, ngày mồng mười trong tháng, Nê-bu-cát-nết-sa vua Ba-by-lôn đến, vua và toàn quân của vua, đánh Giê-ru-sa-lem; vua đóng trại nghịch cùng thành, và họ xây lũy vây quanh thành.
vi.B: Ngày mồng mười tháng mười, năm thứ chín đời Sê-đê-kia, Nê-bu-cát-nết-sa vua Ba-by-lôn đem toàn quân tiến đánh Giê-ru-sa-lem. Vua ấy đóng trại vây thành, và quân lính đắp lũy bao vây thành tứ phía.
vi.R: Năm thứ chín đời Sê-đê-kia làm vua, vào ngày mồng mười tháng mười, Nê-bu-cát-nết-sa, vua Ba-by-lôn, dẫn toàn quân đến đánh Giê-ru-sa-lem. Vua ấy đóng trại quanh thành, và quân lính đắp dốc đất và tường lũy để tấn công thành từ mọi phía.

ko.L: 그리고 그의 통치 제구년 열째 달 십일에 바빌론 왕 느부갓네살이 그와 그의 온 군대와 함께 예루살렘으로 쳐들어와 그것을 향하여 진을 쳤다. 그리고 그들이 그것을 향하여 사방으로 포위벽을 쌓았다.
ko.B: 시드기야가 다스린 지 구 년째 되는 해 열째 달 십일에, 바빌론 왕 느부갓네살이 온 군대를 이끌고 예루살렘으로 쳐들어왔다. 그는 그 성을 향하여 진을 쳤고, 그들은 성 둘레에 사방으로 포위벽을 쌓았다.
ko.R: 시드기야가 왕이 된 지 구 년째 되는 해 열째 달 십일에, 바빌론 왕 느부갓네살이 온 군대를 이끌고 예루살렘을 치러 왔다. 그는 성 둘레에 진을 쳤다. 그의 군인들은 성 둘레 사방에 흙 언덕과 벽을 쌓았다.

decisions.choice: his reign: the reign of Zedekiah
decisions.reason: The last king named is Zedekiah, whom Nebuchadnezzar had set on the throne and who then rebelled against him (24:17-20). The siege is dated by the years of his reign.

decisions.choice: the tenth day of the tenth month of Zedekiah's ninth year: early in 588 BC
decisions.reason: Months are counted from the spring, so the tenth month falls in midwinter. Depending on how the reign years were counted, the siege began early in 588 BC or a year earlier. Ezekiel, among the exiles in Babylon, was told to write down this same day as the day the king of Babylon laid siege to Jerusalem (Ezekiel 24:1-2), and it was later kept as a fast day, "the fast of the tenth month" (Zechariah 8:19).

decisions.choice: siege works: a wall, ramps or towers built around a besieged city
decisions.reason: The word is used only of siege works (Ezekiel 4:2; 17:17; 21:27). It may mean a continuous wall that shut the city in, or the ramps and towers built against its walls; either way, the city was cut off.

decisions.choice: the fall of Jerusalem told again in Jeremiah 52 and 39
decisions.reason: Verses 1-21 and 27-30 of this chapter are repeated almost word for word in Jeremiah 52:4-34, and verses 1-12 are told again more briefly in Jeremiah 39:1-10. This verse matches Jeremiah 52:4; Jeremiah 39:1 gives only the year and month. Jeremiah 52 and 39 have not yet been drafted in this translation, so this wording is drafted fresh; when they are, the shared Hebrew should share its wording.

decisions.choice: Zedekiah (Balanced and Readable); his soldiers (Readable)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable name Zedekiah for "his", since the last verse of the previous chapter is far behind a reader who starts here. Readable says who "they" were who built the siege works, and describes them as ramps and walls.

decisions.choice: "Sedequías"
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable name Zedekiah for "his", as the English does (m1).

source.text: וַתָּבֹ֥א הָעִ֖יר בַּמָּצ֑וֹר עַ֚ד עַשְׁתֵּ֣י עֶשְׂרֵ֣ה שָׁנָ֔ה לַמֶּ֖לֶךְ צִדְקִיָּֽהוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: And came the city into the siege until [the] eleventh year of the king Zedekiah.

en.L: And the city came into the siege until the eleventh year of King Zedekiah.
en.B: The city was under siege until the eleventh year of King Zedekiah.
en.R: The city was surrounded and cut off until Zedekiah's eleventh year as king.

es.L: Y la ciudad estuvo sitiada hasta el año undécimo del rey Sedequías.
es.B: La ciudad estuvo sitiada hasta el año once del rey Sedequías.
es.R: La ciudad estuvo rodeada y aislada hasta el año once del reinado de Sedequías.

fr.L: Et la ville fut assiégée jusqu’à la onzième année du roi Sédécias.
fr.B: La ville resta assiégée jusqu’à la onzième année du roi Sédécias.
fr.R: La ville a été encerclée et coupée du reste du pays jusqu’à la onzième année du règne de Sédécias.

sw.L: Na mji ukazingirwa mpaka mwaka wa kumi na moja wa mfalme Sedekia.
sw.B: Mji ulikuwa umezingirwa mpaka mwaka wa kumi na moja wa mfalme Sedekia.
sw.R: Mji ulizungukwa na kutengwa mpaka mwaka wa kumi na moja wa utawala wa Sedekia.

vi.L: Thành bị vây hãm cho đến năm thứ mười một đời vua Sê-đê-kia.
vi.B: Thành bị vây hãm cho đến năm thứ mười một đời vua Sê-đê-kia.
vi.R: Thành bị bao vây và cô lập cho đến năm thứ mười một đời Sê-đê-kia làm vua.

ko.L: 그리고 그 성은 시드기야 왕의 제십일년까지 포위되어 있었다.
ko.B: 그 성은 시드기야 왕이 다스린 지 십일 년째 되는 해까지 포위되어 있었다.
ko.R: 그 성은 시드기야가 왕이 된 지 십일 년째 되는 해까지 에워싸여 바깥과 끊어져 있었다.

decisions.choice: came into the siege: was besieged
decisions.reason: The city "came into" a state of siege and stayed in it: no one could go in or out, and food could not be brought in.

decisions.choice: until the eleventh year: about a year and a half
decisions.reason: From the tenth month of the ninth year (verse 1) to the fourth month of the eleventh year (verse 3, with Jeremiah 39:2) is about eighteen months. The siege was broken off for a time when an Egyptian army came out (Jeremiah 37:5-11), but the Babylonians returned.

decisions.choice: the same words in Jeremiah 52:5
decisions.reason: Jeremiah 52:5 has the same sentence. Jeremiah 39:2 joins this verse to the next and gives the full date of the breach.

decisions.choice: surrounded and cut off (Readable)
decisions.reason: Readable explains what a siege is instead of using the word.

source.text: בְּתִשְׁעָ֣ה לַחֹ֔דֶשׁ וַיֶּחֱזַ֥ק הָרָעָ֖ב בָּעִ֑יר וְלֹא־הָ֥יָה לֶ֖חֶם לְעַ֥ם הָאָֽרֶץ׃

records.literal_gloss: On [the] ninth of the month, and was severe the famine in the city, and there was no bread for [the] people of the land.

en.L: On the ninth [day] of the [fourth] month the famine was severe in the city, and there was no bread for the people of the land.
en.B: By the ninth day of the fourth month the city was gripped by famine, and the people of the land had no food.
en.R: By the ninth day of the fourth month, there was a terrible famine in the city. The people had nothing left to eat.

es.L: A los nueve [días] del [cuarto] mes, el hambre se agravó en la ciudad, y no había pan para el pueblo de la tierra.
es.B: Para el día nueve del mes cuarto, el hambre se había apoderado de la ciudad, y la gente del país no tenía qué comer.
es.R: Para el día nueve del mes cuarto, había un hambre terrible en la ciudad. La gente ya no tenía nada que comer.

fr.L: Le neuf du [quatrième] mois, la famine devint sévère dans la ville, et il n’y avait pas de pain pour le peuple du pays.
fr.B: Le neuf du quatrième mois, la famine sévissait dans la ville, et le peuple du pays n’avait plus de nourriture.
fr.R: Le neuf du quatrième mois, il y avait une terrible famine dans la ville. Les gens n’avaient plus rien à manger.

sw.L: Siku ya tisa ya [mwezi wa nne] njaa ilikuwa kali mjini, wala hapakuwa na mkate kwa watu wa nchi.
sw.B: Kufikia siku ya tisa ya mwezi wa nne njaa ilikuwa imeushika mji, nao watu wa nchi hawakuwa na chakula.
sw.R: Kufikia siku ya tisa ya mwezi wa nne, kulikuwa na njaa kali sana mjini. Watu hawakuwa na chochote cha kula.

vi.L: Ngày mồng chín [tháng tư], nạn đói trong thành trở nên trầm trọng, và dân trong xứ không còn bánh ăn.
vi.B: Đến ngày mồng chín tháng tư, nạn đói hoành hành trong thành, và dân chúng không còn gì để ăn.
vi.R: Đến ngày mồng chín tháng tư, nạn đói trong thành trở nên khủng khiếp. Dân chúng không còn gì để ăn.

ko.L: [넷째] 달 구일에 성 안에 기근이 심해져서, 그 땅의 백성에게 먹을 빵이 없었다.
ko.B: 넷째 달 구일이 되자 성 안에 기근이 심해져서, 그 땅의 백성에게 먹을 것이 없었다.
ko.R: 넷째 달 구일이 되자 성 안에 무서운 기근이 들었다. 백성에게는 먹을 것이 하나도 남지 않았다.

decisions.choice: the ninth day of the fourth month
alternatives: the ninth day of the month (no month named)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew here names the day but not the month: "on the ninth of the month". The parallel accounts give the full date, "in the fourth month, on the ninth of the month" (Jeremiah 39:2; 52:6), and the number seems to have dropped out of this verse. The fourth month falls in midsummer, in 586 BC or a year earlier. It too was later kept as a fast day (Zechariah 8:19).

decisions.choice: bread: food of any kind
decisions.reason: "Bread" often stands for food in general (Genesis 3:19; Amos 4:6). Jeremiah's account of the siege speaks of bread running out in the city (Jeremiah 37:21; 38:9), and Lamentations 4:4-10 describes the famine.

decisions.choice: the people of the land: the ordinary people shut up in the city
decisions.reason: Elsewhere "the people of the land" can name the landowning citizens of Judah (11:14; 21:24; verse 19). Here it seems to mean the whole common population, including the country people who had fled inside the walls.

decisions.choice: Jeremiah 52:6 names the month
decisions.reason: Jeremiah 52:6 begins "In the fourth month, on the ninth of the month"; otherwise the verse is the same. Jeremiah 39:2 gives only the date, without the famine.

decisions.choice: [fourth] (Literal); fourth (Balanced and Readable)
decisions.reason: The month is supplied from the parallel passages, in brackets at Literal, so that the date is complete.

decisions.choice: "[cuarto]" (L); "cuarto" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The month is supplied from the parallel passages, in brackets at Literal, as the English does (m1).

source.text: וַתִּבָּקַ֣ע הָעִ֗יר וְכָל־אַנְשֵׁ֨י הַמִּלְחָמָ֤ה׀הַלַּ֨יְלָה֙ דֶּ֜רֶךְ שַׁ֣עַר׀בֵּ֣ין הַחֹמֹתַ֗יִם אֲשֶׁר֙ עַל־גַּ֣ן הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ וְכַשְׂדִּ֥ים עַל־הָעִ֖יר סָבִ֑יב וַיֵּ֖לֶךְ דֶּ֥רֶךְ הָעֲרָבָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And was broken into the city, and all [the] men of the war [went] by night [by the] way of [the] gate between the two walls which [was] by [the] garden of the king, and [the] Chaldeans [were] against the city all around; and he went [the] way of the Arabah.

en.L: And the city was broken into, and all the men of war [fled] by night by way of the gate between the two walls, which [was] by the king's garden, while the Chaldeans [were] against the city all around; and he went by way of the Arabah.
en.B: Then the city wall was breached, and all the soldiers fled by night through the gate between the two walls near the king's garden, though the Chaldeans were all around the city. The king went off toward the Arabah.
en.R: Then the enemy broke through the city wall. That night all the soldiers escaped through the gate between the two walls near the king's garden, even though the Babylonians were all around the city. King Zedekiah fled toward the Jordan Valley.

es.L: Y se abrió una brecha en la ciudad, y todos los hombres de guerra [huyeron] de noche por el camino de la puerta entre los dos muros, que [estaba] junto al jardín del rey, mientras los caldeos [estaban] contra la ciudad alrededor; y él se fue por el camino del Arabá.
es.B: Entonces se abrió una brecha en el muro de la ciudad, y todos los soldados huyeron de noche por la puerta que está entre los dos muros, junto al jardín del rey, aunque los caldeos rodeaban la ciudad. El rey se fue en dirección al Arabá.
es.R: Entonces el enemigo abrió una brecha en el muro de la ciudad. Esa noche todos los soldados escaparon por la puerta que está entre los dos muros, cerca del jardín del rey, aunque los babilonios rodeaban la ciudad. El rey Sedequías huyó hacia el valle del Jordán.

fr.L: Et on fit une brèche dans la ville, et tous les hommes de guerre [s’enfuirent] de nuit par le chemin de la porte entre les deux murs, qui [était] près du jardin du roi, tandis que les Chaldéens [étaient] autour de la ville ; et il s’en alla par le chemin de la Araba.
fr.B: Alors on ouvrit une brèche dans la muraille de la ville, et tous les soldats s’enfuirent de nuit par la porte entre les deux murs, près du jardin du roi, alors que les Chaldéens encerclaient la ville. Le roi prit le chemin de la Araba.
fr.R: Ensuite l’ennemi a fait une brèche dans la muraille de la ville. Cette nuit-là, tous les soldats se sont enfuis par la porte entre les deux murs, près du jardin du roi, alors que les Babyloniens étaient tout autour de la ville. Le roi Sédécias s’est enfui vers la vallée du Jourdain.

sw.L: Ndipo mji ukavunjwa, na watu wote wa vita [wakakimbia] usiku kwa njia ya lango lililo kati ya kuta mbili, lililokuwa karibu na bustani ya mfalme, nao Wakaldayo [walikuwa] wameuzunguka mji pande zote; naye akaenda kwa njia ya Araba.
sw.B: Kisha ukuta wa mji ukabomolewa, na askari wote wakakimbia usiku kupitia lango lililo kati ya kuta mbili karibu na bustani ya mfalme, ingawa Wakaldayo walikuwa wameuzunguka mji pande zote. Mfalme akakimbia kuelekea Araba.
sw.R: Kisha adui wakaubomoa ukuta wa mji. Usiku ule askari wote walitoroka kupitia lango lililo kati ya kuta mbili karibu na bustani ya mfalme, ingawa Wababeli walikuwa wameuzunguka mji pande zote. Mfalme Sedekia akakimbia kuelekea Bonde la Yordani.

vi.L: Tường thành bị chọc thủng, và mọi quân lính [chạy trốn] ban đêm theo lối cổng giữa hai bức tường, gần vườn vua, trong khi người Canh-đê vây quanh thành; và vua đi theo đường A-ra-ba.
vi.B: Bấy giờ tường thành bị chọc thủng, và mọi quân lính trốn ra ban đêm qua cổng giữa hai bức tường gần vườn vua, dù người Canh-đê đang vây quanh thành. Vua chạy về hướng A-ra-ba.
vi.R: Rồi quân địch phá thủng tường thành. Đêm ấy mọi binh lính trốn ra qua cổng giữa hai bức tường gần vườn vua, dù quân Ba-by-lôn đang vây quanh thành. Vua Sê-đê-kia chạy trốn về hướng thung lũng sông Giô-đanh.

ko.L: 그리고 성벽이 뚫렸고, 모든 군사가 밤에 왕의 정원 곁에 있는 두 성벽 사이의 문 길로 [도망쳤다]. 갈대아 사람들이 성을 사방으로 에워싸고 있었다. 그리고 그는 아라바 길로 갔다.
ko.B: 마침내 성벽이 뚫리자, 모든 군사가 밤에 왕의 정원 곁에 있는 두 성벽 사이의 문으로 빠져나가 도망쳤다. 갈대아 사람들이 성을 사방으로 에워싸고 있었는데도 그렇게 했다. 왕은 아라바 쪽으로 달아났다.
ko.R: 마침내 적군이 성벽을 뚫었다. 그날 밤 모든 군인이 왕의 정원 근처, 두 성벽 사이에 있는 문으로 빠져나갔다. 바빌로니아 사람들이 성을 사방으로 에워싸고 있었는데도 그렇게 했다. 시드기야 왕은 요단 골짜기 쪽으로 달아났다.

decisions.choice: all the men of war fled by night
alternatives: the verb dropped from the text
decisions.reason: The Hebrew has no verb for the soldiers: "all the men of war ... by night by way of the gate". The parallel accounts have "fled and went out of the city by night" (Jeremiah 52:7; compare 39:4), and the sense is clear from what follows.

decisions.choice: the gate between the two walls by the king's garden: at the south end of the city
decisions.reason: The king's garden lay at the south end of Jerusalem near the Pool of Siloam (Nehemiah 3:15). A gate there between two lines of wall led down into the valley, away from the main Babylonian lines.

decisions.choice: the Chaldeans: the Babylonians
decisions.reason: The Chaldeans were a people of southern Mesopotamia. Nebuchadnezzar's family was Chaldean, so the name came to mean the Babylonians and their army.

decisions.choice: he went: the king, Zedekiah
decisions.reason: The subject is not named, but verse 5 shows it is the king. The Arabah is the deep valley of the Jordan running down to the Dead Sea; Zedekiah was making for the river crossings near Jericho, perhaps to reach Ammon on the far side.

decisions.choice: told again in Jeremiah 52:7 and 39:4
decisions.reason: Jeremiah 52:7 adds that the soldiers "fled and went out of the city" and says "they went" toward the Arabah. Jeremiah 39:4 says that Zedekiah and the soldiers saw the Babylonian officers in the gate and fled.

decisions.choice: [fled] (Literal); fled, escaped (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: A verb is supplied for the soldiers, in brackets at Literal.

decisions.choice: the Babylonians; King Zedekiah; the Jordan Valley (Readable)
decisions.reason: Readable uses the better-known name "Babylonians" for the Chaldeans throughout this chapter, names the king, and explains the Arabah as the Jordan Valley. Balanced says "the king" for "he".

decisions.choice: "los caldeos" (L, B); "los babilonios" (R); "el Arabá" (L, B); "el valle del Jordán" (R)
decisions.reason: Readable uses the better-known name "babilonios" for the Chaldeans through this chapter and names the Arabah, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "les Chaldéens" (L, B); "les Babyloniens" (R)
decisions.reason: As the English, Readable names the Chaldeans by the name readers know, the Babylonians, through this chapter.

decisions.choice: Wakaldayo (Literal, Balanced); Wababeli (Readable)
decisions.reason: The Chaldeans are the Babylonians (meaning decision m3); Readable says so, as the English does, through this chapter.

decisions.choice: người Canh-đê (L, B); quân Ba-by-lôn (R)
decisions.reason: Readable uses the better-known name of the Babylonians for the Chaldeans through this chapter, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "갈대아 사람들" (L, B); "바빌로니아 사람들" (R)
decisions.reason: As the English Readable says "Babylonians" for the Chaldeans, Readable names the people; "바빌론" stays the city and the king's title.

source.text: וַיִּרְדְּפ֤וּ חֵיל־כַּשְׂדִּים֙ אַחַ֣ר הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ וַיַּשִּׂ֥גוּ אֹת֖וֹ בְּעַרְב֣וֹת יְרֵח֑וֹ וְכָל־חֵיל֔וֹ נָפֹ֖צוּ מֵעָלָֽיו׃

records.literal_gloss: And pursued [the] army of [the] Chaldeans after the king, and overtook him in [the] plains of Jericho; and all his army was scattered from him.

en.L: And the army of the Chaldeans pursued the king, and they overtook him in the plains of Jericho; and all his army was scattered from him.
en.B: But the Chaldean army chased the king and caught up with him in the plains of Jericho, and his whole army scattered away from him.
en.R: But the Babylonian army chased after the king and caught up with him on the plains near Jericho. All his soldiers scattered and left him.

es.L: Y el ejército de los caldeos persiguió al rey, y lo alcanzaron en las llanuras de Jericó; y todo su ejército se dispersó de él.
es.B: Pero el ejército caldeo persiguió al rey y lo alcanzó en las llanuras de Jericó, y todo su ejército se dispersó y lo abandonó.
es.R: Pero el ejército babilonio persiguió al rey y lo alcanzó en las llanuras cerca de Jericó. Todos sus soldados se dispersaron y lo dejaron solo.

fr.L: Et l’armée des Chaldéens poursuivit le roi, et ils l’atteignirent dans les plaines de Jéricho ; et toute son armée se dispersa loin de lui.
fr.B: Mais l’armée chaldéenne poursuivit le roi et le rattrapa dans les plaines de Jéricho ; toute son armée se dispersa et l’abandonna.
fr.R: Mais l’armée babylonienne a poursuivi le roi et l’a rattrapé dans les plaines près de Jéricho. Tous ses soldats se sont dispersés et l’ont abandonné.

sw.L: Nalo jeshi la Wakaldayo likamfuatia mfalme, wakampata katika nchi tambarare za Yeriko; na jeshi lake lote likatawanyika kutoka kwake.
sw.B: Lakini jeshi la Wakaldayo lilimfuatia mfalme na kumkuta katika nchi tambarare za Yeriko, na jeshi lake lote likatawanyika na kumwacha.
sw.R: Lakini jeshi la Wababeli lilimfuatia mfalme, likamkuta katika nchi tambarare karibu na Yeriko. Askari wake wote walitawanyika, wakamwacha.

vi.L: Quân Canh-đê đuổi theo vua và bắt kịp vua trong đồng bằng Giê-ri-cô; toàn quân của vua tan tác bỏ vua.
vi.B: Nhưng quân Canh-đê đuổi theo vua và bắt kịp vua trong đồng bằng Giê-ri-cô; toàn quân của vua đều tan rã bỏ vua.
vi.R: Nhưng quân Ba-by-lôn đuổi theo vua và bắt kịp vua ở đồng bằng gần Giê-ri-cô. Mọi binh lính của vua đều tan chạy bỏ vua.

ko.L: 그리고 갈대아 사람들의 군대가 왕을 뒤쫓아 여리고 평지에서 그를 따라잡았다. 그리고 그의 모든 군대는 그에게서 흩어졌다.
ko.B: 그러나 갈대아 군대가 왕을 뒤쫓아 여리고 평지에서 그를 따라잡았다. 그의 군대는 모두 그를 버리고 흩어졌다.
ko.R: 그러나 바빌로니아 군대가 왕을 뒤쫓아 여리고 근처 평지에서 그를 따라잡았다. 그의 군인들은 모두 흩어져서 그를 떠났다.

decisions.choice: the plains of Jericho: the flat valley floor near the Jordan
decisions.reason: Jericho lies in the Jordan Valley some fifteen miles east of Jerusalem and far below it. Zedekiah had almost reached the river.

decisions.choice: his army was scattered from him: they ran off and left him alone
decisions.reason: The soldiers who had fled with him scattered, so the king was taken with no one to defend him. The Hebrew does not say whether they left him before the Babylonians reached him or when they arrived.

decisions.choice: told again in Jeremiah 52:8 and 39:5
decisions.reason: Jeremiah 52:8 has the same sentence; Jeremiah 39:5 joins it to the next verse.

decisions.choice: Babylonian (Readable)
decisions.reason: As in verse 4.

source.text: וַֽיִּתְפְּשׂוּ֙ אֶת־הַמֶּ֔לֶךְ וַיַּעֲל֥וּ אֹת֛וֹ אֶל־מֶ֥לֶךְ בָּבֶ֖ל רִבְלָ֑תָה וַיְדַבְּר֥וּ אִתּ֖וֹ מִשְׁפָּֽט׃

records.literal_gloss: And they seized the king, and brought him up to [the] king of Babylon to Riblah, and they spoke with him judgment.

en.L: And they seized the king and brought him up to the king of Babylon at Riblah, and they spoke judgment with him.
en.B: They seized the king and took him up to Riblah, to the king of Babylon, and there they passed sentence on him.
en.R: They captured King Zedekiah and took him to the king of Babylon at the town of Riblah. There he was put on trial and sentenced.

es.L: Y apresaron al rey y lo hicieron subir al rey de Babilonia, a Ribla, y hablaron con él juicio.
es.B: Apresaron al rey y lo llevaron ante el rey de Babilonia, a Ribla, y allí dictaron sentencia contra él.
es.R: Capturaron al rey Sedequías y lo llevaron ante el rey de Babilonia, en la ciudad de Ribla. Allí lo juzgaron y lo condenaron.

fr.L: Et ils saisirent le roi et le firent monter vers le roi de Babylone à Ribla, et ils prononcèrent contre lui un jugement.
fr.B: On s’empara du roi et on le conduisit à Ribla, auprès du roi de Babylone, qui prononça contre lui la sentence.
fr.R: Ils ont capturé le roi Sédécias et l’ont emmené au roi de Babylone, dans la ville de Ribla. Là, on l’a jugé et condamné.

sw.L: Nao wakamkamata mfalme, wakampandisha kwa mfalme wa Babeli huko Ribla, nao wakasema naye hukumu.
sw.B: Wakamkamata mfalme, wakampeleka Ribla kwa mfalme wa Babeli, na huko wakamhukumu.
sw.R: Walimkamata mfalme Sedekia, wakampeleka kwa mfalme wa Babeli katika mji wa Ribla. Huko alishtakiwa na kuhukumiwa.

vi.L: Họ bắt vua và đem vua lên đến vua Ba-by-lôn tại Ríp-la, và họ phán xét vua.
vi.B: Họ bắt vua và đem lên Ríp-la, đến vua Ba-by-lôn, và tại đó họ tuyên án vua.
vi.R: Họ bắt vua Sê-đê-kia và đưa đến vua Ba-by-lôn tại thành Ríp-la. Tại đó vua bị xét xử và kết án.

ko.L: 그리고 그들이 왕을 사로잡아 리블라에 있는 바빌론 왕에게로 끌고 올라갔고, 그들이 그에게 심판을 선고했다.
ko.B: 그들은 왕을 사로잡아 리블라에 있는 바빌론 왕에게 끌고 올라갔고, 거기에서 그에게 형을 선고했다.
ko.R: 그들은 시드기야 왕을 사로잡아 리블라 성에 있는 바빌론 왕에게 끌고 갔다. 거기에서 그는 재판을 받고 형을 선고받았다.

decisions.choice: Riblah: a town far to the north, in Syria
decisions.reason: Riblah stood on the Orontes River in the land of Hamath (verse 21). Nebuchadnezzar directed his campaign from there, as Pharaoh Neco had held King Jehoahaz there (23:33).

decisions.choice: spoke judgment with him: tried him and passed sentence
decisions.reason: The phrase is used of bringing a legal case against someone (Jeremiah 1:16; 4:12). Zedekiah was judged as a vassal who had broken the oath of loyalty he had sworn to Nebuchadnezzar in God's name (24:20; 2 Chronicles 36:13; Ezekiel 17:13-20).

decisions.choice: Jeremiah: "he spoke judgment with him"
decisions.reason: Jeremiah 52:9 and 39:5 have the singular, "he" (the king of Babylon) passed sentence, and add that Riblah is "in the land of Hamath". Here the verb is plural, "they".

decisions.choice: put on trial and sentenced (Readable)
decisions.reason: Readable spells out the legal sense of the idiom and names the king.

decisions.choice: "hablaron con él juicio"
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew phrase; Balanced and Readable say what it means, a trial and a sentence (m2).

source.text: וְאֶת־בְּנֵי֙ צִדְקִיָּ֔הוּ שָׁחֲט֖וּ לְעֵינָ֑יו וְאֶת־עֵינֵ֤י צִדְקִיָּ֨הוּ֙ עִוֵּ֔ר וַיַּאַסְרֵ֨הוּ֙ בַֽנְחֻשְׁתַּ֔יִם וַיְבִאֵ֖הוּ בָּבֶֽל׃ס

records.literal_gloss: And [the] sons of Zedekiah they slaughtered before his eyes; and [the] eyes of Zedekiah he blinded, and bound him with bronze fetters, and brought him [to] Babylon.

en.L: And they slaughtered the sons of Zedekiah before his eyes; and he put out the eyes of Zedekiah and bound him in bronze fetters and brought him [to] Babylon.
en.B: They slaughtered Zedekiah's sons while he watched. Then the king of Babylon put out Zedekiah's eyes, bound him in bronze fetters and took him to Babylon.
en.R: They killed Zedekiah's sons while he watched. Then the king of Babylon had Zedekiah's eyes put out. He had him bound in bronze chains and taken to Babylon.

es.L: Y a los hijos de Sedequías los degollaron delante de sus ojos; y a Sedequías le sacó los ojos, y lo ató con cadenas de bronce y lo llevó [a] Babilonia.
es.B: Degollaron a los hijos de Sedequías ante sus propios ojos. Luego el rey de Babilonia le sacó los ojos a Sedequías, lo ató con cadenas de bronce y lo llevó a Babilonia.
es.R: Mataron a los hijos de Sedequías mientras él miraba. Luego el rey de Babilonia mandó sacarle los ojos a Sedequías. Lo hizo atar con cadenas de bronce y llevar a Babilonia.

fr.L: Et les fils de Sédécias, ils les égorgèrent sous ses yeux ; et il creva les yeux de Sédécias, le lia d’une double chaîne de bronze et l’emmena [à] Babylone.
fr.B: On égorgea les fils de Sédécias sous ses yeux. Puis le roi de Babylone fit crever les yeux de Sédécias, le fit lier d’une double chaîne de bronze et l’emmena à Babylone.
fr.R: Ils ont tué les fils de Sédécias sous ses yeux. Ensuite le roi de Babylone a fait crever les yeux de Sédécias. Il l’a fait attacher avec des chaînes de bronze et emmener à Babylone.

sw.L: Nao wakawachinja wana wa Sedekia mbele ya macho yake; naye akayapofua macho ya Sedekia, akamfunga kwa minyororo ya shaba, akamleta [hata] Babeli.
sw.B: Waliwachinja wana wa Sedekia akiwa anatazama. Kisha mfalme wa Babeli akayapofua macho ya Sedekia, akamfunga kwa pingu za shaba, akampeleka Babeli.
sw.R: Waliwaua wana wa Sedekia akiwa anatazama. Kisha mfalme wa Babeli akaamuru Sedekia atobolewe macho. Akaamuru afungwe kwa minyororo ya shaba na kupelekwa Babeli.

vi.L: Họ giết các con trai Sê-đê-kia trước mắt ông; rồi vua ấy móc mắt Sê-đê-kia, xiềng ông bằng xích đồng và đem ông [về] Ba-by-lôn.
vi.B: Họ giết các con trai của Sê-đê-kia ngay trước mắt ông. Rồi vua Ba-by-lôn móc mắt Sê-đê-kia, xiềng ông bằng xích đồng và giải ông về Ba-by-lôn.
vi.R: Họ giết các con trai của Sê-đê-kia ngay trước mắt ông. Rồi vua Ba-by-lôn cho móc mắt Sê-đê-kia, xiềng ông bằng xích đồng và giải về Ba-by-lôn.

ko.L: 그리고 그들이 시드기야의 아들들을 그의 눈앞에서 죽였다. 그리고 그가 시드기야의 눈을 멀게 하고, 그를 놋 사슬로 묶어 바빌론으로 끌고 갔다.
ko.B: 그들은 시드기야가 보는 앞에서 그의 아들들을 죽였다. 그리고 바빌론 왕은 시드기야의 두 눈을 뽑고, 그를 놋 사슬로 묶어 바빌론으로 끌고 갔다.
ko.R: 그들은 시드기야가 보는 앞에서 그의 아들들을 죽였다. 그러고 나서 바빌론 왕은 시드기야의 두 눈을 뽑게 했다. 그는 시드기야를 놋 사슬로 묶어 바빌론으로 끌고 가게 했다.

decisions.choice: he put out his eyes: the king of Babylon
decisions.reason: The sons are killed by "they", but the blinding, binding and taking away are done by "he". The parallel passages name him: the king of Babylon (Jeremiah 52:10-11; 39:6-7).

decisions.choice: the sons killed, then the eyes put out
decisions.reason: Killing a rebel king's sons ended his line, and blinding was a punishment for rebel rulers in the ancient Near East; the last thing Zedekiah saw was the death of his sons.

decisions.choice: the prophets' words come true
decisions.reason: Jeremiah had told Zedekiah that he would see the king of Babylon face to face and be taken to Babylon (Jeremiah 32:4-5; 34:3), and Ezekiel had said that the prince would be brought to Babylon "but he will not see it, and there he will die" (Ezekiel 12:13). Both came true.

decisions.choice: bronze fetters: a pair of bronze shackles
decisions.reason: The word is "bronze" in the dual form, meaning a pair of bronze shackles, the same word used of Samson's fetters (Judges 16:21).

decisions.choice: told again in Jeremiah 52:10-11 and 39:6-7
decisions.reason: Jeremiah adds that the king of Babylon also killed the officials of Judah at Riblah, and Jeremiah 52:11 adds that Zedekiah was kept in prison until the day of his death.

decisions.choice: the king of Babylon (Balanced and Readable)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable name the one Hebrew calls "he", from the parallel passages. Readable says he "had" these things done.

source.text: וּבַחֹ֤דֶשׁ הַֽחֲמִישִׁי֙ בְּשִׁבְעָ֣ה לַחֹ֔דֶשׁ הִ֗יא שְׁנַת֙ תְּשַֽׁע־עֶשְׂרֵ֣ה שָׁנָ֔ה לַמֶּ֖לֶךְ נְבֻכַדְנֶאצַּ֣ר מֶֽלֶךְ־בָּבֶ֑ל בָּ֞א נְבוּזַרְאֲדָ֧ן רַב־טַבָּחִ֛ים עֶ֥בֶד מֶֽלֶךְ־בָּבֶ֖ל יְרוּשָׁלִָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And in the month the fifth, on [the] seventh of the month, it [was the] year nineteen year of the king Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, came Nebuzaradan chief of [the] guards, servant of [the] king of Babylon, [to] Jerusalem.

en.L: And in the fifth month, on the seventh [day] of the month, which [was] the nineteenth year of King Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, Nebuzaradan the chief of the guard, a servant of the king of Babylon, came [to] Jerusalem.
en.B: In the fifth month, on the seventh day, the nineteenth year of King Nebuchadnezzar's reign over Babylon, Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard, an official of the king of Babylon, came to Jerusalem.
en.R: On the seventh day of the fifth month, Nebuzaradan came to Jerusalem. He was the commander of the royal guard and an official of the king of Babylon. This was in the nineteenth year that Nebuchadnezzar was king of Babylon.

es.L: Y en el mes quinto, a los siete [días] del mes, que [era] el año diecinueve del rey Nabucodonosor, rey de Babilonia, vino [a] Jerusalén Nabuzaradán, jefe de la guardia, siervo del rey de Babilonia.
es.B: El día siete del mes quinto, en el año diecinueve del reinado de Nabucodonosor sobre Babilonia, Nabuzaradán, capitán de la guardia y funcionario del rey de Babilonia, llegó a Jerusalén.
es.R: El día siete del mes quinto, Nabuzaradán llegó a Jerusalén. Era el comandante de la guardia real y funcionario del rey de Babilonia. Esto sucedió en el año diecinueve del reinado de Nabucodonosor en Babilonia.

fr.L: Et au cinquième mois, le sept du mois, c’[était] la dix-neuvième année du roi Nabuchodonosor, roi de Babylone, Nebouzaradân, chef des gardes, serviteur du roi de Babylone, vint [à] Jérusalem.
fr.B: Le sept du cinquième mois de la dix-neuvième année du règne de Nabuchodonosor, roi de Babylone, Nebouzaradân, le commandant de la garde, officier du roi de Babylone, arriva à Jérusalem.
fr.R: Le sept du cinquième mois, Nebouzaradân est venu à Jérusalem. Il était le chef de la garde royale et un officier du roi de Babylone. C’était la dix-neuvième année du règne de Nabuchodonosor sur Babylone.

sw.L: Na katika mwezi wa tano, siku ya saba ya mwezi, ndio mwaka wa kumi na tisa wa mfalme Nebukadneza mfalme wa Babeli, Nebuzaradani mkuu wa walinzi, mtumishi wa mfalme wa Babeli, akaja [hata] Yerusalemu.
sw.B: Katika mwezi wa tano, siku ya saba, mwaka wa kumi na tisa wa utawala wa mfalme Nebukadneza juu ya Babeli, Nebuzaradani kamanda wa walinzi, afisa wa mfalme wa Babeli, alikuja Yerusalemu.
sw.R: Siku ya saba ya mwezi wa tano, Nebuzaradani alikuja Yerusalemu. Yeye alikuwa kamanda wa walinzi wa mfalme na afisa wa mfalme wa Babeli. Huo ulikuwa mwaka wa kumi na tisa wa utawala wa Nebukadneza juu ya Babeli.

vi.L: Tháng thứ năm, ngày mồng bảy trong tháng, tức năm thứ mười chín đời vua Nê-bu-cát-nết-sa vua Ba-by-lôn, Nê-bu-xa-a-đan, quan chỉ huy vệ binh, đầy tớ của vua Ba-by-lôn, đến Giê-ru-sa-lem.
vi.B: Ngày mồng bảy tháng năm, năm thứ mười chín đời vua Nê-bu-cát-nết-sa trị vì Ba-by-lôn, Nê-bu-xa-a-đan, quan chỉ huy đội cận vệ, một triều thần của vua Ba-by-lôn, đến Giê-ru-sa-lem.
vi.R: Ngày mồng bảy tháng năm, Nê-bu-xa-a-đan đến Giê-ru-sa-lem. Ông là người chỉ huy đội cận vệ của vua và là một quan chức của vua Ba-by-lôn. Lúc ấy là năm thứ mười chín đời Nê-bu-cát-nết-sa làm vua Ba-by-lôn.

ko.L: 그리고 다섯째 달 칠일, 곧 바빌론 왕 느부갓네살 왕의 제십구년에 바빌론 왕의 신하인 경호대장 느부사라단이 예루살렘에 왔다.
ko.B: 바빌론 왕 느부갓네살이 다스린 지 십구 년째 되는 해 다섯째 달 칠일에, 바빌론 왕의 신하인 경호대장 느부사라단이 예루살렘에 왔다.
ko.R: 다섯째 달 칠일에 느부사라단이 예루살렘에 왔다. 그는 바빌론 왕의 신하로서 왕의 경호대를 지휘하는 대장이었다. 그때는 느부갓네살이 바빌론의 왕이 된 지 십구 년째 되는 해였다.

decisions.choice: chief of the guard: literally "chief of the slaughterers"
decisions.reason: The word for the guards first meant butchers or cooks, but in a royal title it names the king's bodyguard, who also carried out executions, as with Potiphar "commander of the guard" (Genesis 37:36). Here it is the title of a senior Babylonian officer. A Babylonian list of Nebuchadnezzar's court officials includes a Nabu-zer-iddin, which is the Babylonian form of the name Nebuzaradan, "the god Nabu has given offspring".

decisions.choice: the fifth month of Nebuchadnezzar's nineteenth year: midsummer 586 BC
decisions.reason: Nebuchadnezzar's nineteenth year is Zedekiah's eleventh (verse 2). The burning of the temple came about a month after the city fell, and "the fast of the fifth month" was later kept in mourning for it (Zechariah 7:3, 5; 8:19).

decisions.choice: Jeremiah 52:12: the tenth day, and "who stood before the king of Babylon"
decisions.reason: Jeremiah 52:12 dates Nebuzaradan's arrival to the tenth of the month, not the seventh, and calls him one "who stood before the king of Babylon", a court officer, instead of "servant". The two dates may count his setting out and his arrival, or one number may have been miscopied. Jeremiah 39:9 gives no date.

decisions.choice: servant (Literal); official (Balanced and Readable)
decisions.reason: As elsewhere for a king's servant who held office, Literal keeps "servant" and Balanced and Readable say "official".

decisions.choice: chief of the guard (Literal); captain of the guard (Balanced); commander of the royal guard (Readable)
decisions.reason: Each level uses its own wording for the title throughout this chapter. Readable moves the date by the king's reign to the end so that the sentence about Nebuzaradan stays short.

decisions.choice: "jefe de la guardia" (L); "capitán de la guardia" (B); "comandante de la guardia real" (R); "siervo" (L), "funcionario" (B, R); "Nabuzaradán"
decisions.reason: One title per level through the chapter, as the English does; "Nabuzaradán" as the terms note's table gives it.

decisions.choice: "chef des gardes" (L); "commandant de la garde" (B); "chef de la garde royale" (R); Nebouzaradân
decisions.reason: The title is literally "chief of the slaughterers" (m1), meaning the commander of the royal guard; Nebouzaradân as the terms note sets.

decisions.choice: mkuu wa walinzi, mtumishi (Literal); kamanda wa walinzi, afisa (Balanced); kamanda wa walinzi wa mfalme, afisa (Readable)
decisions.reason: The title, literally "chief of the slaughterers" (meaning decision m1), names the commander of the royal guard; one wording per level through this chapter.

decisions.choice: quan chỉ huy vệ binh (L); quan chỉ huy đội cận vệ (B); người chỉ huy đội cận vệ (R); đầy tớ / triều thần / quan chức
decisions.reason: The title keeps one wording at each level through the chapter, and the king's servant follows the usual wording.

decisions.choice: "경호대장" (L, B), "왕의 경호대를 지휘하는 대장" (R); "신하" at every level
decisions.reason: The modern word for the captain of the king's guard; "신하" is the settled word for the king's servants (Samuel note), covering both L "servant" and B, R "official".

source.text: וַיִּשְׂרֹ֥ף אֶת־בֵּית־יְהוָ֖ה וְאֶת־בֵּ֣ית הַמֶּ֑לֶךְ וְאֵ֨ת כָּל־בָּתֵּ֧י יְרוּשָׁלִַ֛ם וְאֶת־כָּל־בֵּ֥ית גָּד֖וֹל שָׂרַ֥ף בָּאֵֽשׁ׃

records.literal_gloss: And he burned [the] house of Yahweh and [the] house of the king, and all [the] houses of Jerusalem; and every house of [a] great [one] he burned with fire.

en.L: And he burned the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} and the house of the king and all the houses of Jerusalem; and every great house he burned with fire.
en.B: He burned the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, the king's palace and all the houses of Jerusalem; every important house he burned down.
en.R: He set fire to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}'s temple, the royal palace and all the houses in Jerusalem. He burned down every important building.

es.L: Y quemó la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, y la casa del rey y todas las casas de Jerusalén; y toda casa grande la quemó con fuego.
es.B: Incendió la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, el palacio real y todas las casas de Jerusalén; quemó todas las casas importantes.
es.R: Prendió fuego al templo {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, al palacio real y a todas las casas de Jerusalén. Quemó todos los edificios importantes.

fr.L: Et il brûla la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, et la maison du roi, et toutes les maisons de Jérusalem ; et toute grande maison, il la brûla par le feu.
fr.B: Il incendia la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, le palais royal et toutes les maisons de Jérusalem ; il livra au feu toutes les maisons importantes.
fr.R: Il a mis le feu au temple {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, au palais royal et à toutes les maisons de Jérusalem. Il a brûlé tous les bâtiments importants.

sw.L: Naye akaiteketeza nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} na nyumba ya mfalme na nyumba zote za Yerusalemu; na kila nyumba kubwa akaiteketeza kwa moto.
sw.B: Aliiteketeza nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, ikulu, na nyumba zote za Yerusalemu; kila nyumba muhimu aliiteketeza kwa moto.
sw.R: Aliichoma moto hekalu la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, jumba la mfalme na nyumba zote za Yerusalemu. Aliteketeza kila jengo muhimu.

vi.L: Hắn đốt nhà của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, cung vua và mọi nhà ở Giê-ru-sa-lem; mọi nhà lớn hắn đều dùng lửa đốt.
vi.B: Hắn đốt nhà của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, cung vua và mọi nhà ở Giê-ru-sa-lem; hắn thiêu rụi mọi nhà quan trọng.
vi.R: Hắn phóng hỏa đền thờ của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, hoàng cung và mọi nhà ở Giê-ru-sa-lem. Hắn đốt rụi mọi tòa nhà quan trọng.

ko.L: 그리고 그가 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 집과 왕의 집과 예루살렘의 모든 집을 불살랐다. 큰 집은 모두 그가 불로 태웠다.
ko.B: 그는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 집과 왕궁과 예루살렘의 모든 집을 불살랐다. 귀족들의 큰 집은 모두 불태워 버렸다.
ko.R: 그는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 성전과 왕궁과 예루살렘의 모든 집에 불을 질렀다. 그는 중요한 건물을 모두 불태워 버렸다.

decisions.choice: the house of the LORD burned
decisions.reason: Solomon's temple (1 Kings 6-8) had stood for nearly four hundred years. The LORD had warned that if Israel turned away, the house he had set apart for his name would become a ruin (1 Kings 9:7-9), and had said of Jerusalem, "I will reject this city ... and the house of which I said, My name will be there" (23:27).

decisions.choice: every great house: the houses of the important people
decisions.reason: The Hebrew can mean every large building or the house of every "great one", the leading men of the city. Either way it points to the main buildings of Jerusalem.

decisions.choice: all the houses of Jerusalem; and every great house
alternatives: all the houses of Jerusalem, that is, every great house
decisions.reason: The last clause may simply add the great houses to the list, or it may explain the one before it: "all the houses of Jerusalem, that is, every great house", meaning the important buildings rather than every home.

decisions.choice: told again in Jeremiah 52:13 and 39:8
decisions.reason: Jeremiah 52:13 has the same sentence. Jeremiah 39:8 does not name the temple; it says the Chaldeans burned the king's house and "the house of the people".

decisions.choice: the king's palace; temple (Readable)
decisions.reason: "The house of the king" is the palace at Balanced and Readable. Readable says "temple" for the house of the LORD.

source.text: וְאֶת־חוֹמֹ֥ת יְרוּשָׁלִַ֖ם סָבִ֑יב נָֽתְצוּ֙ כָּל־חֵ֣יל כַּשְׂדִּ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֖ר רַב־טַבָּחִֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: And [the] walls of Jerusalem all around broke down all [the] army of [the] Chaldeans who [were with the] chief of [the] guards.

en.L: And all the army of the Chaldeans who [were with] the chief of the guard broke down the walls around Jerusalem.
en.B: The whole Chaldean army that was with the captain of the guard tore down the walls all around Jerusalem.
en.R: The whole Babylonian army that was with the commander of the guard tore down the walls all around Jerusalem.

es.L: Y todo el ejército de los caldeos que [estaba con] el jefe de la guardia derribó los muros alrededor de Jerusalén.
es.B: Todo el ejército caldeo que estaba con el capitán de la guardia derribó los muros que rodeaban Jerusalén.
es.R: Todo el ejército babilonio que estaba con el comandante de la guardia derribó los muros que rodeaban Jerusalén.

fr.L: Et toute l’armée des Chaldéens qui [était avec] le chef des gardes abattit les murailles de Jérusalem tout autour.
fr.B: Toute l’armée chaldéenne qui accompagnait le commandant de la garde abattit les murailles qui entouraient Jérusalem.
fr.R: Toute l’armée babylonienne qui était avec le chef de la garde a démoli les murailles tout autour de Jérusalem.

sw.L: Na kuta za Yerusalemu pande zote jeshi lote la Wakaldayo [waliokuwa pamoja na] mkuu wa walinzi wakazibomoa.
sw.B: Jeshi lote la Wakaldayo lililokuwa pamoja na kamanda wa walinzi likazibomoa kuta zote zilizozunguka Yerusalemu.
sw.R: Jeshi lote la Wababeli lililokuwa pamoja na kamanda wa walinzi likazibomoa kuta zote zilizozunguka Yerusalemu.

vi.L: Toàn quân Canh-đê [ở với] quan chỉ huy vệ binh phá đổ các tường thành chung quanh Giê-ru-sa-lem.
vi.B: Toàn quân Canh-đê đi theo quan chỉ huy đội cận vệ phá đổ các tường bao quanh Giê-ru-sa-lem.
vi.R: Toàn quân Ba-by-lôn đi theo người chỉ huy đội cận vệ phá đổ các bức tường bao quanh Giê-ru-sa-lem.

ko.L: 그리고 경호대장과 함께 [있던] 갈대아 사람들의 온 군대가 예루살렘 사방의 성벽을 헐었다.
ko.B: 경호대장과 함께 있던 갈대아 군대 전체가 예루살렘 사방의 성벽을 헐어 버렸다.
ko.R: 경호대장과 함께 있던 바빌로니아 군대 전체가 예루살렘 둘레의 성벽을 모두 허물어 버렸다.

decisions.choice: who were with the chief of the guard
decisions.reason: The Hebrew reads "who ... the chief of the guard", without "with". Jeremiah 52:14 has "who were with the chief of the guard", which is the sense here.

decisions.choice: the walls broken down: the city left without defense
decisions.reason: Without walls a city could not protect itself or be counted a city at all. Jerusalem's walls lay in ruins until Nehemiah rebuilt them (Nehemiah 1:3; 2:17).

decisions.choice: told again in Jeremiah 52:14 and 39:8
decisions.reason: Jeremiah 52:14 has the same sentence with "with"; Jeremiah 39:8 says simply that the Chaldeans broke down the walls.

decisions.choice: [were with] (Literal); was with (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: The missing words are supplied from the parallel, in brackets at Literal.

source.text: וְאֵת֩ יֶ֨תֶר הָעָ֜ם הַנִּשְׁאָרִ֣ים בָּעִ֗יר וְאֶת־הַנֹּֽפְלִים֙ אֲשֶׁ֤ר נָפְלוּ֙ עַל־הַמֶּ֣לֶךְ בָּבֶ֔ל וְאֵ֖ת יֶ֣תֶר הֶהָמ֑וֹן הֶגְלָ֕ה נְבוּזַרְאֲדָ֖ן רַב־טַבָּחִֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: And [the] rest of the people who were left in the city, and the deserters who had deserted to the king of Babylon, and [the] rest of the multitude, exiled Nebuzaradan chief of [the] guards.

en.L: And the rest of the people who were left in the city, and the deserters who had deserted to the king of Babylon, and the rest of the multitude, Nebuzaradan the chief of the guard carried into exile.
en.B: Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard carried into exile the rest of the people who were left in the city, those who had deserted to the king of Babylon, and the rest of the population.
en.R: Nebuzaradan, the commander of the guard, took the rest of the people away as captives. These included the people still left in the city, those who had gone over to the side of the king of Babylon, and everyone else.

es.L: Y al resto del pueblo que había quedado en la ciudad, y a los desertores que se habían pasado al rey de Babilonia, y al resto de la multitud, los llevó cautivos Nabuzaradán, jefe de la guardia.
es.B: Nabuzaradán, capitán de la guardia, llevó al destierro al resto del pueblo que había quedado en la ciudad, a los que se habían pasado al rey de Babilonia y al resto de la población.
es.R: Nabuzaradán, el comandante de la guardia, se llevó como prisioneros al resto del pueblo. Entre ellos estaban los que todavía quedaban en la ciudad, los que se habían pasado al lado del rey de Babilonia y todos los demás.

fr.L: Et le reste du peuple qui restait dans la ville, et les déserteurs qui étaient passés au roi de Babylone, et le reste de la multitude, Nebouzaradân, chef des gardes, les déporta.
fr.B: Nebouzaradân, le commandant de la garde, emmena en exil le reste du peuple qui était resté dans la ville, ceux qui étaient passés du côté du roi de Babylone, et le reste de la population.
fr.R: Nebouzaradân, le chef de la garde, a emmené le reste du peuple comme prisonniers. Il y avait parmi eux les gens qui étaient encore dans la ville, ceux qui étaient passés du côté du roi de Babylone, et tous les autres.

sw.L: Na mabaki ya watu waliobaki mjini, na wale waliokimbilia upande wa mfalme wa Babeli, na mabaki ya umati, Nebuzaradani mkuu wa walinzi akawahamisha.
sw.B: Nebuzaradani kamanda wa walinzi aliwachukua uhamishoni watu waliobaki mjini, wale waliokuwa wamekimbilia upande wa mfalme wa Babeli, na wengine wote waliobaki.
sw.R: Nebuzaradani, kamanda wa walinzi, aliwachukua mateka watu wengine wote. Hao walikuwa watu waliokuwa wamebaki mjini, wale waliokuwa wamejiunga na upande wa mfalme wa Babeli, na wengine wote.

vi.L: Phần dân còn sót lại trong thành, những kẻ đầu hàng đã theo vua Ba-by-lôn, và phần đám đông còn lại, Nê-bu-xa-a-đan, quan chỉ huy vệ binh, bắt đi lưu đày.
vi.B: Nê-bu-xa-a-đan, quan chỉ huy đội cận vệ, bắt đi lưu đày phần dân còn sót lại trong thành, những người đã đầu hàng vua Ba-by-lôn, và phần dân chúng còn lại.
vi.R: Nê-bu-xa-a-đan, người chỉ huy đội cận vệ, bắt những người còn lại đem đi làm tù binh. Trong số đó có những người còn sót lại trong thành, những người đã chạy sang phe vua Ba-by-lôn, và mọi người khác.

ko.L: 그리고 성 안에 남아 있던 나머지 백성과 바빌론 왕에게 넘어간 투항자들과 나머지 무리를 경호대장 느부사라단이 사로잡아 갔다.
ko.B: 경호대장 느부사라단은 성 안에 남아 있던 나머지 백성과 바빌론 왕에게 투항한 사람들과 나머지 주민들을 사로잡아 갔다.
ko.R: 경호대장 느부사라단은 나머지 백성을 포로로 잡아갔다. 성 안에 아직 남아 있던 사람들과 바빌론 왕의 편으로 넘어간 사람들과 그 밖의 모든 사람이 끌려갔다.

decisions.choice: fell to the king of Babylon: deserted to him
decisions.reason: To "fall to" an enemy means to go over to his side. Jeremiah had urged the people to do this to save their lives (Jeremiah 21:9; 38:2), and Zedekiah feared those who had done so (Jeremiah 38:19).

decisions.choice: the multitude: the rest of the population
decisions.reason: The word means a crowd or throng. Jeremiah 52:15 has a word that differs by one letter and means "craftsmen" or "master workers"; Jeremiah 39:9 repeats "the rest of the people who remained" instead.

decisions.choice: carried into exile: the second great deportation
decisions.reason: Eleven years earlier Nebuchadnezzar had taken King Jehoiachin, the leading men and the craftsmen to Babylon (24:14-16). Now the rest of the city's people went the same way.

decisions.choice: told again in Jeremiah 52:15 and 39:9
decisions.reason: Besides the word noted above, Jeremiah 52:15 begins the list with "some of the poorest of the people".

decisions.choice: Nebuzaradan ... carried into exile (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew puts the three groups first and the verb and its subject last. Literal keeps that order; Balanced and Readable start with Nebuzaradan, and Readable lists the groups in a second sentence.

source.text: וּמִדַּלַּ֣ת הָאָ֔רֶץ הִשְׁאִ֖יר רַב־טַבָּחִ֑ים לְכֹֽרְמִ֖ים וּלְיֹגְבִֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: And some of [the] poor of the land left [the] chief of [the] guards for vinedressers and for field-workers.

en.L: But some of the poorest of the land the chief of the guard left as vinedressers and as field workers.
en.B: But the captain of the guard left some of the poorest people of the land to tend the vineyards and work the fields.
en.R: But the commander of the guard left behind some of the poorest people in the land. He had them take care of the vineyards and work the fields.

es.L: Pero de los pobres de la tierra dejó el jefe de la guardia [algunos] como viñadores y labradores.
es.B: Pero el capitán de la guardia dejó a algunos de los más pobres del país para que cuidaran las viñas y trabajaran los campos.
es.R: Pero el comandante de la guardia dejó a algunos de los más pobres del país. Les mandó cuidar las viñas y trabajar los campos.

fr.L: Mais des plus pauvres du pays, le chef des gardes en laissa comme vignerons et comme laboureurs.
fr.B: Mais le commandant de la garde laissa une partie des plus pauvres du pays pour cultiver les vignes et travailler les champs.
fr.R: Mais le chef de la garde a laissé sur place quelques-uns des plus pauvres du pays. Il leur a fait cultiver les vignes et travailler les champs.

sw.L: Lakini baadhi ya maskini wa nchi mkuu wa walinzi akawaacha wawe watunza mizabibu na wakulima.
sw.B: Lakini kamanda wa walinzi aliwaacha baadhi ya watu maskini kabisa wa nchi ili watunze mashamba ya mizabibu na kulima mashamba.
sw.R: Lakini kamanda wa walinzi aliwaacha baadhi ya watu maskini kabisa wa nchi. Aliwaagiza watunze mashamba ya mizabibu na kulima mashamba.

vi.L: Nhưng một số người nghèo nhất trong xứ, quan chỉ huy vệ binh để lại làm người trồng nho và người làm ruộng.
vi.B: Nhưng quan chỉ huy đội cận vệ để lại một số người nghèo nhất trong xứ để chăm sóc vườn nho và cày cấy ruộng đất.
vi.R: Nhưng người chỉ huy đội cận vệ để lại một số người nghèo nhất trong xứ. Ông bắt họ chăm sóc các vườn nho và làm ruộng.

ko.L: 그러나 그 땅의 가난한 자들 가운데 일부를 경호대장이 포도원을 가꾸는 자와 농부로 남겨 두었다.
ko.B: 그러나 경호대장은 그 땅의 가장 가난한 사람들 가운데 일부를 남겨 두어 포도원을 가꾸고 밭을 갈게 했다.
ko.R: 그러나 경호대장은 그 땅의 가장 가난한 사람들 가운데 몇을 남겨 두었다. 그는 그들에게 포도원을 돌보고 밭을 갈게 했다.

decisions.choice: field workers: probably plowmen or farm laborers
decisions.reason: The word appears only here and in Jeremiah 52:16, and its exact sense is not known. The setting beside "vinedressers" shows it names some kind of work on the land, perhaps plowing or tilling.

decisions.choice: some of the poorest left to work the land
decisions.reason: The land was not left empty. Those who had owned nothing were left to keep the vineyards and fields producing, and Jeremiah 39:10 says they were given vineyards and fields. When Jehoiachin was taken, likewise, "no one remained except the poorest people of the land" (24:14).

decisions.choice: told again in Jeremiah 52:16 and 39:10
decisions.reason: Jeremiah 52:16 has the same sentence; Jeremiah 39:10 adds that Nebuzaradan gave the poor vineyards and fields on that day.

decisions.choice: to tend the vineyards and work the fields (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable describe the work instead of using the nouns "vinedressers" and "field workers".

source.text: וְאֶת־עַמּוּדֵ֨י הַנְּחֹ֜שֶׁת אֲשֶׁ֣ר בֵּית־יְהוָ֗ה וְֽאֶת־הַמְּכֹנ֞וֹת וְאֶת־יָ֧ם הַנְּחֹ֛שֶׁת אֲשֶׁ֥ר בְּבֵית־יְהוָ֖ה שִׁבְּר֣וּ כַשְׂדִּ֑ים וַיִּשְׂא֥וּ אֶת־נְחֻשְׁתָּ֖ם בָּבֶֽלָה׃

records.literal_gloss: And [the] pillars of the bronze which [were in the] house of Yahweh, and the stands, and [the] sea of the bronze which [was] in [the] house of Yahweh, broke in pieces [the] Chaldeans, and carried their bronze to Babylon.

en.L: And the pillars of bronze that [were in] the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, and the stands and the sea of bronze that [was] in the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, the Chaldeans broke in pieces, and they carried their bronze to Babylon.
en.B: The Chaldeans broke up the bronze pillars that were in the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, the stands, and the bronze Sea that was in the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, and they hauled the metal off to Babylon.
en.R: The Babylonians broke into pieces the bronze pillars in {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}'s temple, the bronze stands on wheels, and the huge bronze tank called the Sea. They carried all the bronze away to Babylon.

es.L: Y las columnas de bronce que [estaban en] la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, y las basas, y el mar de bronce que [estaba] en la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, los caldeos los hicieron pedazos, y llevaron su bronce a Babilonia.
es.B: Los caldeos hicieron pedazos las columnas de bronce que estaban en la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, las basas y el Mar de bronce que estaba en la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, y se llevaron el metal a Babilonia.
es.R: Los babilonios hicieron pedazos las columnas de bronce del templo {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, las basas de bronce con ruedas y el enorme depósito de bronce llamado el Mar. Se llevaron todo el bronce a Babilonia.

fr.L: Et les colonnes de bronze qui [étaient dans] la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, et les bases, et la Mer de bronze qui [était] dans la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, les Chaldéens les mirent en pièces, et ils en emportèrent le bronze à Babylone.
fr.B: Les Chaldéens brisèrent les colonnes de bronze qui se trouvaient dans la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, les bases et la Mer de bronze qui était dans la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, et ils en emportèrent le métal à Babylone.
fr.R: Les Babyloniens ont cassé en morceaux les colonnes de bronze du temple {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, les bases de bronze à roues et l’énorme cuve de bronze appelée la Mer. Ils ont emporté tout le bronze à Babylone.

sw.L: Na nguzo za shaba zilizokuwa [katika] nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, na vitako na bahari ya shaba iliyokuwa katika nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, Wakaldayo wakavivunja vipande vipande, wakaipeleka shaba yake Babeli.
sw.B: Wakaldayo walizivunja vipande vipande nguzo za shaba zilizokuwa katika nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, vitako, na Bahari ya shaba iliyokuwa katika nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, wakaipeleka shaba yake Babeli.
sw.R: Wababeli walizivunja vipande vipande nguzo za shaba katika hekalu la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, vitako vya shaba vyenye magurudumu, na tangi kubwa la shaba lililoitwa Bahari. Wakaipeleka shaba yote Babeli.

vi.L: Các trụ bằng đồng [ở trong] nhà của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, các chân đế và cái biển bằng đồng ở trong nhà của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, người Canh-đê đập vỡ, và chở đồng của chúng về Ba-by-lôn.
vi.B: Người Canh-đê đập vỡ các trụ bằng đồng trong nhà của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, các chân đế và cái Biển bằng đồng trong nhà của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, rồi chở hết đồng về Ba-by-lôn.
vi.R: Quân Ba-by-lôn đập vỡ các trụ bằng đồng trong đền thờ của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, các chân đế bằng đồng có bánh xe, và cái bể lớn bằng đồng gọi là cái Biển. Họ chở hết đồng về Ba-by-lôn.

ko.L: 그리고 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 집에 [있던] 놋 기둥들과 받침대들과 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 집에 있던 놋 바다를 갈대아 사람들이 깨뜨려 그 놋을 바빌론으로 가져갔다.
ko.B: 갈대아 사람들은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 집에 있던 놋 기둥들과 받침대들과 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 집에 있던 놋 바다를 깨뜨려, 그 놋을 바빌론으로 실어 갔다.
ko.R: 바빌로니아 사람들은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 성전에 있던 놋 기둥들과 바퀴 달린 놋 받침대들과 '바다'라고 부르던 커다란 놋 물통을 깨뜨렸다. 그들은 그 놋을 모두 바빌론으로 가져갔다.

decisions.choice: the pillars, the stands and the Sea that Solomon had made
decisions.reason: These are the great bronze works cast for Solomon's temple: the two pillars at the porch (1 Kings 7:15-22), the great basin called the Sea (1 Kings 7:23-26), and the ten wheeled stands for basins of water (1 Kings 7:27-37). The pillars were named Jachin and Boaz (1 Kings 7:21), but they are not named here.

decisions.choice: broken in pieces and the bronze carried off
decisions.reason: The pieces were too large to carry whole, so they were broken up and taken for their metal. Jeremiah had warned that the pillars, the Sea and the stands still left in the temple would be carried to Babylon (Jeremiah 27:19-22).

decisions.choice: the same words in Jeremiah 52:17
decisions.reason: Jeremiah 52:17 has the same sentence.

decisions.choice: the Sea; stands on wheels, a huge bronze tank called the Sea (Readable)
decisions.reason: As in 1 Kings 7:23 and 27, Balanced writes "the Sea" as a name, and Readable says what the stands and the Sea were. Readable says "temple" for the house of the LORD and mentions it once.

decisions.choice: "el mar de bronce" (L); "el Mar de bronce" (B); "el enorme depósito de bronce llamado el Mar" (R)
decisions.reason: As the terms note sets ("el Mar de bronce") and as at 16:17; Literal keeps a common noun as the English does, and Readable explains the Sea and the stands.

decisions.choice: "la Mer de bronze"; "les bases"
decisions.reason: Solomon's furnishings as the terms note sets them; Readable explains the Sea, as in 16:17.

decisions.choice: "놋 바다" (L, B); R explains it
decisions.reason: The terms note's name for Solomon's bronze Sea.

source.text: וְאֶת־הַסִּירֹ֨ת וְאֶת־הַיָּעִ֜ים וְאֶת־הַֽמְזַמְּר֣וֹת וְאֶת־הַכַּפּ֗וֹת וְאֵ֨ת כָּל־כְּלֵ֧י הַנְּחֹ֛שֶׁת אֲשֶׁ֥ר יְשָֽׁרְתוּ־בָ֖ם לָקָֽחוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: And the pots and the shovels and the snuffers and the dishes and all [the] vessels of the bronze which they served with them, they took.

en.L: And the pots and the shovels and the snuffers and the dishes and all the vessels of bronze with which they served, they took away.
en.B: They also took away the pots, the shovels, the wick trimmers, the dishes and all the bronze utensils used in the temple service.
en.R: They also took the pots, shovels, wick trimmers and dishes, and all the other bronze things used in the worship at the temple.

es.L: Y las ollas, y las palas, y las despabiladeras, y los platos y todos los utensilios de bronce con que ministraban, se los llevaron.
es.B: También se llevaron las ollas, las palas, las despabiladeras, los platos y todos los utensilios de bronce que se usaban en el servicio del templo.
es.R: También se llevaron las ollas, las palas, las tijeras para las mechas y los platos, y todas las demás cosas de bronce que se usaban en el culto del templo.

fr.L: Et les pots, les pelles, les mouchettes, les coupes et tous les ustensiles de bronze avec lesquels on faisait le service, ils les emportèrent.
fr.B: Ils emportèrent aussi les pots, les pelles, les mouchettes, les coupes et tous les ustensiles de bronze qui servaient au culte.
fr.R: Ils ont aussi pris les pots, les pelles, les ciseaux pour les mèches, les coupes et tous les autres objets de bronze qui servaient au culte dans le temple.

sw.L: Na masufuria na majembe na makasi ya utambi na sahani na vyombo vyote vya shaba walivyotumikia navyo, wakavichukua.
sw.B: Walichukua pia masufuria, majembe, makasi ya kukata utambi, sahani na vyombo vyote vya shaba vilivyotumika katika huduma ya hekalu.
sw.R: Walichukua pia masufuria, majembe, makasi ya kukata utambi na sahani, na vitu vingine vyote vya shaba vilivyotumika katika ibada hekaluni.

vi.L: Các nồi, xẻng, kéo cắt bấc, đĩa, và mọi khí cụ bằng đồng dùng trong việc phục vụ, họ đều lấy đi.
vi.B: Họ cũng lấy đi các nồi, xẻng, kéo cắt tim đèn, đĩa và mọi đồ dùng bằng đồng dùng trong việc phụng sự tại đền thờ.
vi.R: Họ cũng lấy các nồi, xẻng, kéo cắt tim đèn, đĩa, và mọi đồ vật bằng đồng khác dùng trong việc thờ phượng tại đền thờ.

ko.L: 그리고 솥들과 부삽들과 심지 자르는 가위들과 접시들과, 그들이 섬길 때 쓰던 모든 놋 기구를 그들이 가져갔다.
ko.B: 그들은 또 솥과 부삽과 심지 자르는 가위와 접시와, 성전 예배에 쓰던 모든 놋 기구를 가져갔다.
ko.R: 그들은 또 솥과 부삽과 심지 자르는 가위와 접시와, 성전에서 예배드릴 때 쓰던 다른 놋 물건들도 모두 가져갔다.

decisions.choice: pots, shovels, snuffers, dishes: tools for the altar, the lamps and the incense
decisions.reason: The pots carried away ashes and the shovels served the altar (1 Kings 7:40, 45); the snuffers trimmed the lamp wicks (1 Kings 7:50); the dishes held incense (Numbers 7:14).

decisions.choice: served: the priests' ministry in the temple
decisions.reason: The verb is used of the priests' service at the altar and in the sanctuary (Exodus 28:43; Numbers 4:12).

decisions.choice: Jeremiah 52:18 adds the basins
decisions.reason: Jeremiah 52:18 has the same list with "the basins" added after the snuffers.

decisions.choice: snuffers (Literal); wick trimmers (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: As in 1 Kings 7:50.

decisions.choice: in the temple service, in the worship at the temple (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: "They served with them" is the priests' service in the temple; Balanced and Readable say so.

decisions.choice: "mouchettes" (L, B); "ciseaux pour les mèches" (R)
decisions.reason: Tools for trimming lamp wicks (m1); "mouchettes" is the French word, and Readable says what they were.

decisions.choice: majembe; makasi ya utambi (Literal); makasi ya kukata utambi (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: The temple tools in plain Swahili: small shovels for the altar ashes and trimmers for the lamp wicks.

source.text: וְאֶת־הַמַּחְתּוֹת֙ וְאֶת־הַמִּזְרָק֗וֹת אֲשֶׁ֤ר זָהָב֙ זָהָ֔ב וַאֲשֶׁר־כֶּ֖סֶף כָּ֑סֶף לָקַ֖ח רַב־טַבָּחִֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: And the firepans and the bowls, which [were] gold [as] gold, and which [were] silver [as] silver, took [the] chief of [the] guards.

en.L: And the firepans and the bowls, what [was] gold, gold, and what [was] silver, silver, the chief of the guard took away.
en.B: The captain of the guard took away the firepans and the sprinkling bowls, everything that was made of gold and everything that was made of silver.
en.R: The commander of the guard also took the fire pans and the sprinkling bowls. He took everything made of gold and everything made of silver.

es.L: Y los braseros y los tazones, lo que [era] de oro, de oro, y lo que [era] de plata, de plata, se los llevó el jefe de la guardia.
es.B: El capitán de la guardia se llevó los braseros y los tazones para rociar, todo lo que era de oro y todo lo que era de plata.
es.R: El comandante de la guardia también se llevó los braseros y los tazones para rociar. Se llevó todo lo que era de oro y todo lo que era de plata.

fr.L: Et les brasiers et les bols, ce qui [était] d’or, en or, et ce qui [était] d’argent, en argent, le chef des gardes les emporta.
fr.B: Le commandant de la garde emporta les brasiers et les coupes à aspersion, tout ce qui était en or et tout ce qui était en argent.
fr.R: Le chef de la garde a aussi pris les brasiers et les coupes pour l’aspersion. Il a pris tout ce qui était en or et tout ce qui était en argent.

sw.L: Na vyetezo na mabakuli, kilichokuwa dhahabu, dhahabu, na kilichokuwa fedha, fedha, mkuu wa walinzi akavichukua.
sw.B: Kamanda wa walinzi alichukua vyetezo na mabakuli ya kunyunyizia, kila kitu kilichotengenezwa kwa dhahabu na kila kitu kilichotengenezwa kwa fedha.
sw.R: Kamanda wa walinzi alichukua pia vyetezo na mabakuli ya kunyunyizia. Alichukua kila kitu kilichotengenezwa kwa dhahabu na kila kitu kilichotengenezwa kwa fedha.

vi.L: Các lư hương và các chén, thứ bằng vàng ra vàng, thứ bằng bạc ra bạc, quan chỉ huy vệ binh lấy đi.
vi.B: Quan chỉ huy đội cận vệ lấy đi các lư hương và các chén rảy, mọi thứ làm bằng vàng và mọi thứ làm bằng bạc.
vi.R: Người chỉ huy đội cận vệ cũng lấy các lư hương và các chén rảy. Ông lấy mọi thứ làm bằng vàng và mọi thứ làm bằng bạc.

ko.L: 그리고 불 옮기는 그릇들과 대접들, 금으로 된 것은 금으로, 은으로 된 것은 은으로, 경호대장이 가져갔다.
ko.B: 경호대장은 불 옮기는 그릇과 뿌리는 대접을 가져갔는데, 금으로 만든 것은 금대로, 은으로 만든 것은 은대로 모두 가져갔다.
ko.R: 경호대장은 불 옮기는 그릇과 피를 뿌리는 대접도 가져갔다. 그는 금으로 만든 것과 은으로 만든 것을 모두 가져갔다.

decisions.choice: gold, gold; silver, silver: everything of gold and everything of silver
alternatives: of pure gold and pure silver
taken for their gold and silver
decisions.reason: The doubled word gathers everything of that metal: whatever was gold and whatever was silver. Some take it to stress the metal, "pure gold" or "for their gold", that is, taken for the value of the metal.

decisions.choice: the last of the temple's treasures
decisions.reason: Nebuchadnezzar had already cut up the gold vessels Solomon made when he took Jehoiachin (24:13). Later the temple vessels in Babylon were used at Belshazzar's feast (Daniel 5:2-3) and given back by Cyrus (Ezra 1:7-11).

decisions.choice: Jeremiah 52:19 lists more
decisions.reason: Jeremiah 52:19 has a longer list of what the captain of the guard took: basins, firepans, bowls, pots, lampstands, dishes and cups.

decisions.choice: firepans; bowls (Literal), sprinkling bowls (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: As in 1 Kings 7:40 and 50; Readable writes "fire pans".

source.text: הָעַמּוּדִ֣ים׀שְׁנַ֗יִם הַיָּ֤ם הָֽאֶחָד֙ וְהַמְּכֹנ֔וֹת אֲשֶׁר־עָשָׂ֥ה שְׁלֹמֹ֖ה לְבֵ֣ית יְהוָ֑ה לֹא־הָיָ֣ה מִשְׁקָ֔ל לִנְחֹ֖שֶׁת כָּל־הַכֵּלִ֥ים הָאֵֽלֶּה׃

records.literal_gloss: The pillars two, the sea the one, and the stands which made Solomon for [the] house of Yahweh, there was no weight to [the] bronze of all the vessels these.

en.L: The two pillars, the one sea, and the stands that Solomon had made for the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}: there was no weight for the bronze of all these vessels.
en.B: As for the two pillars, the one Sea and the stands Solomon made for the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, the bronze of all these things was more than could be weighed.
en.R: The two pillars, the Sea and the stands that King Solomon had made for {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}'s temple held so much bronze that no one could weigh it.

es.L: Las dos columnas, el mar único y las basas que Salomón había hecho para la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}: no había peso para el bronce de todos estos utensilios.
es.B: En cuanto a las dos columnas, el único Mar y las basas que Salomón había hecho para la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, el bronce de todas estas cosas era más de lo que se podía pesar.
es.R: Las dos columnas, el Mar y las basas que el rey Salomón había hecho para el templo {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} tenían tanto bronce que nadie podía pesarlo.

fr.L: Les deux colonnes, la Mer unique et les bases que Salomon avait faites pour la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, il n’y avait pas de poids pour le bronze de tous ces objets.
fr.B: Quant aux deux colonnes, à la Mer et aux bases que Salomon avait faites pour la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, le bronze de tous ces objets était impossible à peser.
fr.R: Les deux colonnes, la Mer et les bases que le roi Salomon avait fabriquées pour le temple {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} contenaient tellement de bronze que personne n’aurait pu le peser.

sw.L: Nguzo mbili, bahari moja, na vitako ambavyo Sulemani alivifanya kwa ajili ya nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}: shaba ya vyombo hivi vyote haikuwa na uzito [uliopimika].
sw.B: Kuhusu nguzo mbili, Bahari moja na vitako ambavyo Sulemani alivifanya kwa ajili ya nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, shaba ya vitu hivyo vyote ilikuwa nyingi mno kupimwa.
sw.R: Nguzo mbili, Bahari na vitako ambavyo mfalme Sulemani alivitengeneza kwa ajili ya hekalu la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} vilikuwa na shaba nyingi mno hata hakuna mtu aliyeweza kuipima.

vi.L: Hai cây trụ, một cái biển, và các chân đế mà Sa-lô-môn đã làm cho nhà của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}: đồng của mọi khí cụ ấy không thể cân được.
vi.B: Còn hai cây trụ, một cái Biển và các chân đế Sa-lô-môn đã làm cho nhà của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, thì đồng của tất cả các vật ấy nhiều không cân xuể.
vi.R: Hai cây trụ, cái Biển và các chân đế mà vua Sa-lô-môn đã làm cho đền thờ của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} chứa nhiều đồng đến nỗi không ai cân nổi.

ko.L: 솔로몬이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 집을 위하여 만든 기둥 둘과 바다 하나와 받침대들, 이 모든 기구의 놋은 무게를 달 수 없었다.
ko.B: 솔로몬이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 집을 위하여 만든 두 기둥과 바다 하나와 받침대들로 말하자면, 이 모든 기구의 놋은 너무 많아서 무게를 달 수 없었다.
ko.R: 솔로몬 왕이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 성전을 위해 만든 두 기둥과 '바다'와 받침대들에는 놋이 너무 많아서 아무도 그 무게를 달 수 없었다.

decisions.choice: there was no weight: it was too much to weigh
decisions.reason: The words repeat 1 Kings 7:47, where Solomon left the bronze unweighed because there was so much of it. What was too great to weigh when the temple was built is now carried away.

decisions.choice: the list stands first, then what is said about it
decisions.reason: The verse names the great pieces again and then comments on them, a way of summing up verses 13-15.

decisions.choice: Jeremiah 52:20 adds the twelve bronze oxen
decisions.reason: Jeremiah 52:20 adds "the twelve bronze oxen that were under" the Sea. Kings says that King Ahaz had taken the Sea down from the oxen and set it on a stone base (16:17), which may be why the oxen are not named here.

decisions.choice: the Sea; King Solomon (Readable)
decisions.reason: Readable leaves out "one" with the Sea and adds Solomon's title.

source.text: שְׁמֹנֶה֩ עֶשְׂרֵ֨ה אַמָּ֜ה קוֹמַ֣ת׀הָעַמּ֣וּד הָאֶחָ֗ד וְכֹתֶ֨רֶת עָלָ֥יו׀נְחֹשֶׁת֮ וְקוֹמַ֣ת הַכֹּתֶרֶת֮ שָׁלֹ֣שׁ אַמּוֹת֒ וּשְׂבָכָ֨ה וְרִמֹּנִ֧ים עַֽל־הַכֹּתֶ֛רֶת סָבִ֖יב הַכֹּ֣ל נְחֹ֑שֶׁת וְכָאֵ֛לֶּה לַֽעַמּ֥וּד הַשֵּׁנִ֖י עַל־הַשְּׂבָכָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: Eighteen cubit[s] [was the] height of the pillar the one, and a capital on it [of] bronze, and [the] height of the capital three cubits, and a network and pomegranates on the capital all around, the whole [of] bronze; and like these [was] to the pillar the second, with the network.

en.L: Eighteen cubits [was] the height of the one pillar, and on it [was] a capital of bronze; and the height of the capital [was] three cubits, and a network and pomegranates [were] on the capital all around, all of bronze; and the second pillar [had] the like, with the network.
en.B: One pillar was {{units:about 27 feet|eighteen cubits}} high, with a bronze capital on top of it. The capital was {{units:about 4 1/2 feet|three cubits}} high, with a network and pomegranates all around it, all of bronze. The second pillar, with its network, was the same.
en.R: The first pillar was {{units:about 27 feet|eighteen cubits}} tall. It had a bronze top, called a capital, that was {{units:about 4 1/2 feet|three cubits}} tall. All around the capital was a net of lattice work with pomegranates on it, all made of bronze. The second pillar was just the same.

es.L: Dieciocho codos [era] la altura de una columna, y sobre ella [había] un capitel de bronce; y la altura del capitel [era] de tres codos, y una red y granadas [había] sobre el capitel alrededor, todo de bronce; y semejante a esto [tenía] la segunda columna, con la red.
es.B: Una columna medía {{units:unos 8,10 metros|dieciocho codos}} de alto, y tenía encima un capitel de bronce. El capitel medía {{units:unos 1,35 metros|tres codos}} de alto, con una red y granadas alrededor, todo de bronce. La segunda columna, con su red, era igual.
es.R: La primera columna medía {{units:unos 8,10 metros|dieciocho codos}} de alto. Tenía encima una pieza de bronce, llamada capitel, que medía {{units:unos 1,35 metros|tres codos}} de alto. Alrededor del capitel había una red de bronce con granadas, todo hecho de bronce. La segunda columna era igual.

fr.L: Dix-huit coudées [était] la hauteur de l’une des colonnes, et sur elle [il y avait] un chapiteau de bronze ; et la hauteur du chapiteau [était] de trois coudées, et un treillis et des grenades [étaient] sur le chapiteau tout autour, le tout de bronze ; et la seconde colonne [était] pareille, avec le treillis.
fr.B: Une colonne mesurait {{units:environ 8 mètres|dix-huit coudées}} de haut et portait un chapiteau de bronze. Le chapiteau avait {{units:environ 1,35 mètre|trois coudées}} de haut, avec un treillis et des grenades tout autour, le tout en bronze. La seconde colonne, avec son treillis, était semblable.
fr.R: La première colonne mesurait {{units:environ 8 mètres|dix-huit coudées}} de haut. Elle avait au sommet une pièce de bronze, appelée chapiteau, haute de {{units:environ 1,35 mètre|trois coudées}}. Tout autour du chapiteau, il y avait un filet en treillis décoré de grenades, le tout en bronze. La seconde colonne était exactement pareille.

sw.L: Urefu wa nguzo moja [ulikuwa] dhiraa kumi na nane, na juu yake [kulikuwa na] kichwa cha shaba; na urefu wa kichwa [ulikuwa] dhiraa tatu, na wavu na makomamanga [yalikuwa] juu ya kichwa pande zote, yote ya shaba; na nguzo ya pili [ilikuwa na] mfano wa hayo, pamoja na wavu.
sw.B: Nguzo moja ilikuwa na urefu wa {{units:karibu mita 8|dhiraa kumi na nane}}, na juu yake kulikuwa na kichwa cha shaba. Kichwa hicho kilikuwa na urefu wa {{units:karibu mita 1.35|dhiraa tatu}}, na wavu na makomamanga pande zote, vyote vya shaba. Nguzo ya pili, pamoja na wavu wake, ilikuwa vivyo hivyo.
sw.R: Nguzo ya kwanza ilikuwa na urefu wa {{units:karibu mita 8|dhiraa kumi na nane}}. Juu yake kulikuwa na kipande cha shaba kilichoitwa kichwa, chenye urefu wa {{units:karibu mita 1.35|dhiraa tatu}}. Kuzunguka kichwa hicho kulikuwa na wavu wa kazi ya kusuka wenye makomamanga, vyote vya shaba. Nguzo ya pili ilikuwa sawasawa kabisa.

vi.L: Chiều cao của một cây trụ [là] mười tám cu-đê, trên đó có một đầu trụ bằng đồng; chiều cao của đầu trụ ba cu-đê, có lưới và trái lựu chung quanh đầu trụ, tất cả bằng đồng; cây trụ thứ hai cũng [có] như vậy, với lưới.
vi.B: Một cây trụ cao {{units:8,1 m|mười tám cu-đê}}, trên đỉnh có đầu trụ bằng đồng. Đầu trụ cao {{units:1,35 m|ba cu-đê}}, chung quanh có lưới và trái lựu, tất cả đều bằng đồng. Cây trụ thứ hai, với lưới của nó, cũng giống như vậy.
vi.R: Cây trụ thứ nhất cao {{units:8,1 m|mười tám cu-đê}}. Trên đỉnh có một phần đầu bằng đồng, gọi là đầu trụ, cao {{units:1,35 m|ba cu-đê}}. Chung quanh đầu trụ có một tấm lưới đan với những trái lựu, tất cả đều bằng đồng. Cây trụ thứ hai cũng giống hệt như vậy.

ko.L: 한 기둥의 높이는 십팔 규빗이었고, 그 위에 놋으로 된 기둥머리가 있었다. 그리고 기둥머리의 높이는 삼 규빗이었고, 기둥머리 둘레에 그물과 석류들이 있었는데, 모두 놋이었다. 그리고 둘째 기둥도 그물과 함께 이와 같았다.
ko.B: 기둥 하나는 {{units:약 8.1미터|십팔 규빗}} 높이였고, 그 위에 놋 기둥머리가 얹혀 있었다. 그 기둥머리는 {{units:약 1.35미터|삼 규빗}} 높이였고, 그 둘레에 그물과 석류들이 있었는데, 모두 놋이었다. 둘째 기둥도 그물까지 이와 같았다.
ko.R: 첫째 기둥은 {{units:약 8.1미터|십팔 규빗}} 높이였다. 그 위에는 기둥머리라고 부르는 놋 머리 장식이 있었는데, {{units:약 1.35미터|삼 규빗}} 높이였다. 기둥머리 둘레에는 그물 모양 장식과 석류들이 있었고, 모두 놋으로 만들었다. 둘째 기둥도 똑같았다.

decisions.choice: three cubits: the capital's height here; five in 1 Kings 7:16
decisions.reason: 1 Kings 7:16, Jeremiah 52:22 and 2 Chronicles 3:15 all give the capitals a height of five cubits. The three here may be a copying error, or it may measure only part of the capital, leaving out the lily work at its top (1 Kings 7:19). The Hebrew of this verse is followed.

decisions.choice: network and pomegranates: a lattice with bronze fruit
decisions.reason: As in 1 Kings 7:17-20, the network is a lattice of crossing bands around the capital, and the pomegranates are bronze ornaments in rows on it.

decisions.choice: the pillars described in 1 Kings 7:15-22 and Jeremiah 52:21-23
decisions.reason: The height of eighteen cubits matches 1 Kings 7:15. Jeremiah 52:21-23 adds the measure around each pillar (twelve cubits), that they were hollow, the thickness of the metal (four fingers), and the number of pomegranates (ninety-six on the sides, a hundred in all).

decisions.choice: like these to the second pillar: the second was the same
decisions.reason: Everything said of the first pillar holds for the second, "with the network" naming the part just described.

decisions.choice: a bronze top, called a capital (Readable)
decisions.reason: As in 1 Kings 7:16, Readable explains "capital" the first time.

decisions.choice: {{units:unos 8,10 metros|dieciocho codos}}; {{units:unos 1,35 metros|tres codos}}
decisions.reason: The cubit at 45 cm, as the terms notes set; Literal keeps the cubits, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "environ 8 mètres" / "dix-huit coudées"; "environ 1,35 mètre" / "trois coudées"
decisions.reason: The cubit at 45 cm, as the terms note sets, where the English converts to feet; Literal keeps the cubits.

decisions.choice: {{units:karibu mita 8|dhiraa kumi na nane}}; {{units:karibu mita 1.35|dhiraa tatu}}
decisions.reason: Metric by default at 45 cm to the cubit, with the cubits as the alternative; the English gives feet. Literal keeps the cubits.

decisions.choice: {{units:8,1 m|mười tám cu-đê}}; {{units:1,35 m|ba cu-đê}}
decisions.reason: Metric by default with the cubit at 45 cm, the original unit as the alternative; Literal keeps cubits.

decisions.choice: units spans "약 8.1미터" / "십팔 규빗" and "약 1.35미터" / "삼 규빗", followed by "높이였다"
decisions.reason: Metric with a cubit of 45 cm, as the terms note fixes; the span is followed by the noun "높이" so one ending fits both wordings. Literal keeps the cubits.

source.text: וַיִּקַּ֣ח רַב־טַבָּחִ֗ים אֶת־שְׂרָיָה֙ כֹּהֵ֣ן הָרֹ֔אשׁ וְאֶת־צְפַנְיָ֖הוּ כֹּהֵ֣ן מִשְׁנֶ֑ה וְאֶת־שְׁלֹ֖שֶׁת שֹׁמְרֵ֥י הַסַּֽף׃

records.literal_gloss: And took [the] chief of [the] guards Seraiah [the] priest of the head, and Zephaniah [the] priest of second [rank], and [the] three keepers of the threshold.

en.L: And the chief of the guard took Seraiah the head priest and Zephaniah the second priest and the three keepers of the threshold.
en.B: The captain of the guard also seized Seraiah the chief priest, Zephaniah the priest next to him, and the three doorkeepers.
en.R: The commander of the guard also arrested Seraiah the high priest, Zephaniah the priest next in rank, and the three men who guarded the temple entrance.
