es.L: Y el jefe de la guardia tomó a Seraías, el sacerdote principal, y a Sofonías, el segundo sacerdote, y a los tres guardianes del umbral.
es.B: El capitán de la guardia también apresó a Seraías, el sacerdote principal, a Sofonías, el sacerdote que le seguía en rango, y a los tres porteros.
es.R: El comandante de la guardia también arrestó a Seraías, el sumo sacerdote, a Sofonías, el sacerdote que le seguía en rango, y a los tres hombres que cuidaban la entrada del templo.

fr.L: Et le chef des gardes prit Seraya le prêtre en chef, et Sophonie le second prêtre, et les trois gardiens du seuil.
fr.B: Le commandant de la garde prit aussi Seraya, le prêtre en chef, Sophonie, le prêtre en second, et les trois gardiens du seuil.
fr.R: Le chef de la garde a aussi arrêté Seraya, le grand prêtre, Sophonie, le prêtre qui venait après lui, et les trois hommes qui gardaient l’entrée du temple.

sw.L: Naye mkuu wa walinzi akamchukua Seraya kuhani mkuu na Sefania kuhani wa pili, na walinzi watatu wa kizingiti.
sw.B: Kamanda wa walinzi alimkamata pia Seraya kuhani mkuu, Sefania kuhani aliyefuata kwa cheo, na mabawabu watatu.
sw.R: Kamanda wa walinzi alimkamata pia Seraya kuhani mkuu, Sefania kuhani aliyefuata kwa cheo, na watu watatu waliolinda mlango wa hekalu.

vi.L: Quan chỉ huy vệ binh bắt Sê-ra-gia, thầy tế lễ đứng đầu, Sô-phô-ni, thầy tế lễ bậc thứ hai, và ba người giữ ngưỡng cửa.
vi.B: Quan chỉ huy đội cận vệ cũng bắt Sê-ra-gia, thầy tế lễ cả, Sô-phô-ni, thầy tế lễ phó, và ba người giữ cửa.
vi.R: Người chỉ huy đội cận vệ cũng bắt giữ Sê-ra-gia, thầy tế lễ thượng phẩm, Sô-phô-ni, thầy tế lễ bậc kế tiếp, và ba người canh giữ lối vào đền thờ.

ko.L: 그리고 경호대장이 으뜸 제사장 스라야와 버금 제사장 스바냐와 세 문지기를 붙잡았다.
ko.B: 경호대장은 또 대제사장 스라야와 그다음 서열의 제사장 스바냐와 세 문지기를 붙잡았다.
ko.R: 경호대장은 또 대제사장 스라야와 그다음 서열의 제사장 스바냐와 성전 입구를 지키던 세 사람을 체포했다.

decisions.choice: Seraiah the head priest: the high priest
decisions.reason: "The head priest" is the leading priest of the temple (2 Chronicles 19:11; 26:20). Seraiah was the grandson of Hilkiah, the high priest under Josiah (22:4), and an ancestor of Ezra (1 Chronicles 5:39-40; Ezra 7:1). His son Jehozadak was taken into exile (1 Chronicles 5:41).

decisions.choice: Zephaniah the second priest: the high priest's deputy
decisions.reason: The priest "of second rank" was next after the high priest (23:4). Zephaniah son of Maaseiah carried messages between King Zedekiah and Jeremiah (Jeremiah 21:1; 29:25-29; 37:3).

decisions.choice: the keepers of the threshold: senior temple officers
decisions.reason: They guarded the entrances of the temple and received the money brought in (12:10; 22:4). The three were probably the heads of the gatekeepers.

decisions.choice: the same words in Jeremiah 52:24
decisions.reason: Jeremiah 52:24 has the same sentence.

decisions.choice: arrested; the high priest; the men who guarded the temple entrance (Readable)
decisions.reason: Readable says plainly what "took" means here and explains the titles. Balanced says "doorkeepers".

decisions.choice: "Seraías", "Sofonías"; "los guardianes del umbral" (L); "los porteros" (B); "los hombres que cuidaban la entrada del templo" (R)
decisions.reason: The names in their usual Spanish forms; the titles worded as at 22:4.

source.text: וּמִן־הָעִ֡יר לָקַח֩ סָרִ֨יס אֶחָ֜ד אֲֽשֶׁר־ה֥וּא פָקִ֣יד׀עַל־אַנְשֵׁ֣י הַמִּלְחָמָ֗ה וַחֲמִשָּׁ֨ה אֲנָשִׁ֜ים מֵרֹאֵ֤י פְנֵֽי־הַמֶּ֨לֶךְ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר נִמְצְא֣וּ בָעִ֔יר וְאֵ֗ת הַסֹּפֵר֙ שַׂ֣ר הַצָּבָ֔א הַמַּצְבִּ֖א אֶת־עַ֣ם הָאָ֑רֶץ וְשִׁשִּׁ֥ים אִישׁ֙ מֵעַ֣ם הָאָ֔רֶץ הַֽנִּמְצְאִ֖ים בָּעִֽיר׃

records.literal_gloss: And from the city he took one official who he [was] appointed over [the] men of the war, and five men of [those] seeing [the] face of the king who were found in the city, and the scribe [of the] commander of the army, the one mustering the people of the land, and sixty men of [the] people of the land, the ones found in the city.

en.L: And from the city he took one eunuch who [was] the overseer over the men of war, and five men of those who saw the face of the king, who were found in the city, and the scribe of the commander of the army, who mustered the people of the land, and sixty men of the people of the land who were found in the city.
en.B: From the city he took an official who had been in charge of the soldiers, five of the king's advisers who were found in the city, the secretary of the commander of the army, who mustered the people of the land for war, and sixty of the people of the land who were still in the city.
en.R: From the city he also took the officer in charge of the soldiers and five of the king's close advisers who were still in the city. He took the army commander's secretary, who called up the men of the land to serve in the army. He also took sixty of those men who were still in the city.

es.L: Y de la ciudad tomó a un eunuco que [era] el encargado de los hombres de guerra, y a cinco hombres de los que veían el rostro del rey que se hallaron en la ciudad, y al escriba del jefe del ejército, que reclutaba al pueblo de la tierra, y a sesenta hombres del pueblo de la tierra que se hallaron en la ciudad.
es.B: De la ciudad tomó a un funcionario que había estado a cargo de los soldados, a cinco de los consejeros del rey que se encontraban en la ciudad, al secretario del jefe del ejército, que reclutaba para la guerra al pueblo de la tierra, y a sesenta hombres del pueblo de la tierra que todavía estaban en la ciudad.
es.R: De la ciudad también tomó al oficial encargado de los soldados y a cinco de los consejeros más cercanos del rey que todavía estaban en la ciudad. Tomó al secretario del jefe del ejército, que llamaba a los hombres del país a servir en el ejército. También tomó a sesenta de esos hombres que todavía estaban en la ciudad.

fr.L: Et de la ville il prit un eunuque qui était préposé aux hommes de guerre, et cinq hommes de ceux qui voyaient la face du roi, qui se trouvaient dans la ville, et le secrétaire du chef de l’armée, qui recrutait le peuple du pays, et soixante hommes du peuple du pays qui se trouvaient dans la ville.
fr.B: Il prit dans la ville un haut fonctionnaire qui commandait les soldats, cinq des conseillers du roi qu’on trouva dans la ville, le secrétaire du chef de l’armée, qui enrôlait le peuple du pays pour la guerre, et soixante hommes du peuple du pays qui se trouvaient encore dans la ville.
fr.R: Dans la ville, il a aussi pris l’officier qui commandait les soldats, et cinq des proches conseillers du roi qui étaient encore là. Il a pris le secrétaire du chef de l’armée, qui appelait les hommes du pays à servir dans l’armée. Il a aussi pris soixante de ces hommes qui étaient encore dans la ville.

sw.L: Na kutoka mjini akamchukua towashi mmoja aliyekuwa msimamizi juu ya watu wa vita, na watu watano wa wale walioona uso wa mfalme, walioonekana mjini, na mwandishi wa jemadari wa jeshi, aliyewaandikisha watu wa nchi, na watu sitini wa watu wa nchi walioonekana mjini.
sw.B: Kutoka mjini alimchukua afisa mmoja aliyekuwa msimamizi wa askari, washauri watano wa mfalme walioonekana mjini, katibu wa mkuu wa jeshi, aliyewaandikisha watu wa nchi kwenda vitani, na watu sitini wa watu wa nchi waliokuwa bado mjini.
sw.R: Kutoka mjini alimchukua pia afisa aliyesimamia askari na washauri watano wa karibu wa mfalme waliokuwa bado mjini. Alimchukua katibu wa mkuu wa jeshi, aliyewaita watu wa nchi kujiunga na jeshi. Pia aliwachukua watu sitini wa hao waliokuwa bado mjini.

vi.L: Từ trong thành hắn bắt một hoạn quan là người được giao cai quản quân lính, năm người trong số những người được thấy mặt vua còn ở trong thành, viên thư ký của tướng chỉ huy quân đội, là người tuyển mộ dân trong xứ, và sáu mươi người trong dân của xứ còn ở trong thành.
vi.B: Từ trong thành hắn bắt một triều thần đã chỉ huy quân lính, năm cố vấn của vua còn ở trong thành, viên thư ký của tướng chỉ huy quân đội, là người lo tuyển mộ dân trong xứ ra trận, và sáu mươi người dân trong xứ còn ở trong thành.
vi.R: Từ trong thành hắn cũng bắt viên quan chỉ huy quân lính và năm cố vấn thân cận của vua còn ở trong thành. Hắn bắt viên thư ký của tướng chỉ huy quân đội, là người gọi đàn ông trong xứ nhập ngũ. Hắn cũng bắt sáu mươi người trong số những người ấy còn ở trong thành.

ko.L: 그리고 그가 성에서 군사들을 맡은 내시 하나와, 성 안에서 발견된 왕의 얼굴을 보는 자들 다섯 명과, 그 땅의 백성을 징집하던 군대 사령관의 서기관과, 성 안에서 발견된 그 땅의 백성 육십 명을 붙잡았다.
ko.B: 그는 또 성 안에서 군사를 맡은 관리 하나와, 성 안에 있던 왕의 측근 다섯 명과, 그 땅의 백성을 군대로 징집하던 군대 사령관의 서기관과, 성 안에 남아 있던 그 땅의 백성 육십 명을 붙잡았다.
ko.R: 그는 또 성 안에서 군인들을 지휘하던 관리와, 아직 성 안에 남아 있던 왕의 가까운 신하 다섯 명을 잡아갔다. 그는 그 땅의 사람들을 불러 모아 군대에 들어가게 하던 군대 사령관의 서기관도 잡아갔다. 그리고 성 안에 남아 있던 그 땅의 사람 육십 명도 잡아갔다.

decisions.choice: official: a royal officer
decisions.reason: The word can mean a eunuch, but it was also a general title for a high officer of the king (Genesis 37:36). Here it is a military officer in command of the soldiers.

decisions.choice: those who saw the face of the king: his closest advisers
decisions.reason: Only trusted counselors were allowed into the king's presence (Esther 1:14). Jeremiah 52:25 says there were seven of them, not five.

decisions.choice: the scribe of the commander of the army
alternatives: the scribe, who was commander of the army
decisions.reason: The Hebrew reads "the scribe, the commander of the army", which could mean that the secretary also commanded the army. Jeremiah 52:25 reads "the scribe of the commander of the army", and the next words, "who mustered the people of the land", fit a secretary who kept the lists for calling men up.

decisions.choice: the people of the land: the landholding men of Judah
decisions.reason: Here the phrase names the citizens of Judah who held land and were called up to fight (11:14; 21:24; 23:30). The sixty were probably leading men of that class.

decisions.choice: told again in Jeremiah 52:25
decisions.reason: Jeremiah 52:25 has "seven men" for "five men" and "the scribe of the commander"; otherwise it is the same.

decisions.choice: the king's advisers; mustered ... for war (Balanced); called up ... to serve in the army (Readable)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say who "those who saw the king's face" were, and what mustering was for. Readable splits the list into three sentences and uses "army commander" for the title, as elsewhere in these books.

decisions.choice: eunuch (Literal); official (Balanced); officer (Readable)
decisions.reason: As set for these books, Literal keeps "eunuch" for this word and Balanced and Readable say what he was here, a royal officer (m1).

decisions.choice: "eunuco" (L); "funcionario" (B); "oficial" (R); "los que veían el rostro del rey" (L); "consejeros del rey" (B, R)
decisions.reason: As the terms note sets for *sarisim*, with Readable following the English "officer"; Balanced and Readable say who saw the king's face (m2).

decisions.choice: "eunuque" (L); "haut fonctionnaire" (B); "officier" (R)
decisions.reason: *Saris* as the terms note sets, with Readable following the English "officer".

decisions.choice: walioona uso wa mfalme
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew "those who saw the king's face", his closest advisers (meaning decision m2).

source.text: וַיִּקַּ֣ח אֹתָ֔ם נְבוּזַרְאֲדָ֖ן רַב־טַבָּחִ֑ים וַיֹּ֧לֶךְ אֹתָ֛ם עַל־מֶ֥לֶךְ בָּבֶ֖ל רִבְלָֽתָה׃

records.literal_gloss: And took them Nebuzaradan chief of [the] guards, and brought them to [the] king of Babylon to Riblah.

en.L: And Nebuzaradan the chief of the guard took them and brought them to the king of Babylon, to Riblah.
en.B: Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard led them away to Riblah and brought them before the king of Babylon.
en.R: Nebuzaradan, the commander of the guard, took them all to the king of Babylon at Riblah.

es.L: Y Nabuzaradán, jefe de la guardia, los tomó y los llevó al rey de Babilonia, a Ribla.
es.B: Nabuzaradán, capitán de la guardia, se los llevó a Ribla y los presentó ante el rey de Babilonia.
es.R: Nabuzaradán, el comandante de la guardia, los llevó a todos ante el rey de Babilonia, en Ribla.

fr.L: Et Nebouzaradân, chef des gardes, les prit et les conduisit vers le roi de Babylone, à Ribla.
fr.B: Nebouzaradân, le commandant de la garde, les emmena à Ribla et les amena devant le roi de Babylone.
fr.R: Nebouzaradân, le chef de la garde, les a tous emmenés au roi de Babylone, à Ribla.

sw.L: Naye Nebuzaradani mkuu wa walinzi akawachukua, akawaleta kwa mfalme wa Babeli huko Ribla.
sw.B: Nebuzaradani kamanda wa walinzi aliwachukua mpaka Ribla, akawaleta mbele ya mfalme wa Babeli.
sw.R: Nebuzaradani, kamanda wa walinzi, aliwapeleka wote kwa mfalme wa Babeli huko Ribla.

vi.L: Nê-bu-xa-a-đan, quan chỉ huy vệ binh, bắt họ và đem họ đến vua Ba-by-lôn tại Ríp-la.
vi.B: Nê-bu-xa-a-đan, quan chỉ huy đội cận vệ, giải họ đến Ríp-la, trình vua Ba-by-lôn.
vi.R: Nê-bu-xa-a-đan, người chỉ huy đội cận vệ, đem tất cả họ đến vua Ba-by-lôn tại Ríp-la.

ko.L: 그리고 경호대장 느부사라단이 그들을 붙잡아 리블라에 있는 바빌론 왕에게로 끌고 갔다.
ko.B: 경호대장 느부사라단은 그들을 리블라로 끌고 가서 바빌론 왕 앞에 데려갔다.
ko.R: 경호대장 느부사라단은 그들을 모두 리블라에 있는 바빌론 왕에게 데려갔다.

decisions.choice: Riblah: Nebuchadnezzar's camp in Syria
decisions.reason: As in verse 6, where Zedekiah had been judged.

decisions.choice: the same words in Jeremiah 52:26
decisions.reason: Jeremiah 52:26 has the same sentence.

source.text: וַיַּ֣ךְ אֹתָם֩ מֶ֨לֶךְ בָּבֶ֧ל וַיְמִיתֵ֛ם בְּרִבְלָ֖ה בְּאֶ֣רֶץ חֲמָ֑ת וַיִּ֥גֶל יְהוּדָ֖ה מֵעַ֥ל אַדְמָתֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: And struck them [the] king of Babylon and put them to death at Riblah in [the] land of Hamath. And went into exile Judah from upon its land.

en.L: And the king of Babylon struck them and put them to death at Riblah in the land of Hamath. So Judah went into exile from its land.
en.B: The king of Babylon had them struck down and executed at Riblah, in the land of Hamath. So Judah went into exile, away from its own land.
en.R: The king of Babylon had them killed there at Riblah, in the land of Hamath. So the people of Judah were taken away from their land as captives.

es.L: Y el rey de Babilonia los hirió y les dio muerte en Ribla, en la tierra de Hamat. Así fue llevado cautivo Judá de sobre su tierra.
es.B: El rey de Babilonia los hizo matar y ejecutar en Ribla, en la tierra de Hamat. Así Judá fue llevado al destierro, lejos de su propia tierra.
es.R: El rey de Babilonia los mandó matar allí, en Ribla, en la tierra de Hamat. Así la gente de Judá fue llevada prisionera lejos de su tierra.

fr.L: Et le roi de Babylone les frappa et les fit mourir à Ribla, au pays de Hamath. Et Juda fut déporté loin de sa terre.
fr.B: Le roi de Babylone les fit frapper et exécuter à Ribla, au pays de Hamath. Ainsi Juda fut emmené en exil, loin de sa terre.
fr.R: Le roi de Babylone les a fait tuer là, à Ribla, au pays de Hamath. Ainsi, le peuple de Juda a été emmené loin de son pays comme prisonnier.

sw.L: Naye mfalme wa Babeli akawapiga, akawaua huko Ribla katika nchi ya Hamathi. Basi Yuda akahamishwa kutoka katika nchi yake.
sw.B: Mfalme wa Babeli aliwapiga na kuwaua huko Ribla, katika nchi ya Hamathi. Basi Yuda walichukuliwa uhamishoni, mbali na nchi yao wenyewe.
sw.R: Mfalme wa Babeli aliamuru wauawe huko Ribla, katika nchi ya Hamathi. Basi watu wa Yuda walichukuliwa mateka kutoka katika nchi yao.

vi.L: Vua Ba-by-lôn đánh họ và giết họ tại Ríp-la trong xứ Ha-mát. Vậy Giu-đa bị lưu đày khỏi đất mình.
vi.B: Vua Ba-by-lôn cho đánh giết họ tại Ríp-la, trong xứ Ha-mát. Vậy Giu-đa bị lưu đày khỏi đất của mình.
vi.R: Vua Ba-by-lôn cho giết họ tại Ríp-la, trong xứ Ha-mát. Vậy dân Giu-đa bị bắt đem khỏi đất mình làm tù binh.

ko.L: 그리고 바빌론 왕이 하맛 땅 리블라에서 그들을 쳐 죽였다. 이렇게 유다가 자기 땅에서 사로잡혀 갔다.
ko.B: 바빌론 왕은 하맛 땅 리블라에서 그들을 쳐 죽이게 했다. 이렇게 유다는 자기 땅에서 사로잡혀 갔다.
ko.R: 바빌론 왕은 하맛 땅 리블라에서 그들을 죽이게 했다. 이렇게 유다 백성은 포로가 되어 자기 땅에서 끌려갔다.

decisions.choice: the land of Hamath: the region of central Syria
decisions.reason: Hamath was a kingdom on the Orontes River, north of Israel; Riblah lay in its territory.

decisions.choice: Judah went into exile from its land
decisions.reason: The same words were said of the northern kingdom: "Israel went into exile from its land" (17:23). The LORD had warned that unfaithfulness would end in exile (Leviticus 26:33; Deuteronomy 28:36, 64), and had said that he would remove Judah from his sight as he had removed Israel (23:27).

decisions.choice: Jeremiah 52:27 is the same; then the accounts part
decisions.reason: Jeremiah 52:27 has the same sentence. Jeremiah then lists the numbers taken into exile in three deportations (Jeremiah 52:28-30), while Kings tells instead what became of those left in the land (verses 22-26).

decisions.choice: the people of Judah (Readable)
decisions.reason: Readable says "the people of Judah" for the nation, and "as captives" for going into exile.

source.text: וְהָעָ֗ם הַנִּשְׁאָר֙ בְּאֶ֣רֶץ יְהוּדָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר הִשְׁאִ֔יר נְבֽוּכַדְנֶאצַּ֖ר מֶ֣לֶךְ בָּבֶ֑ל וַיַּפְקֵ֣ד עֲלֵיהֶ֔ם אֶת־גְּדַלְיָ֖הוּ בֶּן־אֲחִיקָ֥ם בֶּן־שָׁפָֽן׃פ

records.literal_gloss: And the people who remained in [the] land of Judah, whom left Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, and he appointed over them Gedaliah son of Ahikam son of Shaphan.

en.L: And [as for] the people who remained in the land of Judah, whom Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon had left, he appointed over them Gedaliah son of Ahikam son of Shaphan.
en.B: Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon made Gedaliah son of Ahikam, the son of Shaphan, governor over the people he had left in the land of Judah.
en.R: Nebuchadnezzar, the king of Babylon, put Gedaliah son of Ahikam, the son of Shaphan, in charge of the people he had left behind in the land of Judah.

es.L: Y [en cuanto al] pueblo que quedó en la tierra de Judá, al que dejó Nabucodonosor, rey de Babilonia, puso sobre ellos a Gedalías hijo de Ahicam, hijo de Safán.
es.B: Nabucodonosor, rey de Babilonia, nombró a Gedalías hijo de Ahicam, hijo de Safán, gobernador del pueblo que había dejado en la tierra de Judá.
es.R: Nabucodonosor, el rey de Babilonia, puso a Gedalías hijo de Ahicam, hijo de Safán, a cargo de la gente que había dejado en la tierra de Judá.

fr.L: Et [quant au] peuple qui restait dans le pays de Juda, que Nabuchodonosor, roi de Babylone, avait laissé, il établit sur eux Guedalia fils d’Ahiqam fils de Shaphân.
fr.B: Nabuchodonosor, roi de Babylone, établit Guedalia, fils d’Ahiqam, fils de Shaphân, gouverneur du peuple qu’il avait laissé dans le pays de Juda.
fr.R: Nabuchodonosor, le roi de Babylone, a mis Guedalia fils d’Ahiqam, fils de Shaphân, à la tête des gens qu’il avait laissés dans le pays de Juda.

sw.L: Na [kuhusu] watu waliobaki katika nchi ya Yuda, ambao Nebukadneza mfalme wa Babeli aliwaacha, akamweka juu yao Gedalia mwana wa Ahikamu mwana wa Shafani.
sw.B: Nebukadneza mfalme wa Babeli alimweka Gedalia mwana wa Ahikamu, mwana wa Shafani, kuwa mtawala juu ya watu aliowaacha katika nchi ya Yuda.
sw.R: Nebukadneza, mfalme wa Babeli, alimweka Gedalia mwana wa Ahikamu, mwana wa Shafani, kuwa msimamizi wa watu aliowaacha katika nchi ya Yuda.

vi.L: [Còn] dân còn lại trong xứ Giu-đa, mà Nê-bu-cát-nết-sa vua Ba-by-lôn đã để lại, vua ấy lập Ghê-đa-lia con trai A-hi-cam, con trai Sa-phan, cai quản họ.
vi.B: Nê-bu-cát-nết-sa vua Ba-by-lôn lập Ghê-đa-lia con trai A-hi-cam, cháu Sa-phan, làm tổng đốc cai quản dân vua ấy đã để lại trong xứ Giu-đa.
vi.R: Nê-bu-cát-nết-sa, vua Ba-by-lôn, giao cho Ghê-đa-lia con trai A-hi-cam, cháu Sa-phan, cai quản những người vua ấy đã để lại trong xứ Giu-đa.

ko.L: 그리고 바빌론 왕 느부갓네살이 유다 땅에 남겨 둔 백성에 [대하여는], 그가 사반의 손자 아히감의 아들 그다랴를 그들 위에 세웠다.
ko.B: 바빌론 왕 느부갓네살은 유다 땅에 남겨 둔 백성을 다스리도록 사반의 손자요 아히감의 아들인 그다랴를 총독으로 세웠다.
ko.R: 바빌론 왕 느부갓네살은 유다 땅에 남겨 둔 백성을 맡아 다스리게 하려고 아히감의 아들 그다랴를 세웠다. 그다랴는 사반의 손자였다.

decisions.choice: Gedaliah son of Ahikam son of Shaphan: from a leading family of officials
decisions.reason: Shaphan was King Josiah's secretary, and his son Ahikam was among those Josiah sent to inquire about the book of the law (22:3-14). Ahikam had protected Jeremiah when others wanted him put to death (Jeremiah 26:24). The family had supported Jeremiah's counsel to submit to Babylon.

decisions.choice: appointed over them: made him governor
decisions.reason: No title is given, but Gedaliah was set over the people left in Judah, answering to the king of Babylon (Jeremiah 40:5, 7).

decisions.choice: verses 22-26 sum up Jeremiah 40-43
decisions.reason: The story of Gedaliah, his murder and the flight to Egypt is told at length in Jeremiah 40:7-41:18 and 43:1-7. Kings gives a short summary.

decisions.choice: Nebuchadnezzar ... made Gedaliah ... governor over (Balanced); put Gedaliah in charge (Readable)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew names the people first and then says "he appointed over them". Balanced and Readable start with Nebuchadnezzar, the one who made the appointment; Balanced uses "governor" for the office (see the meaning decision above).

decisions.choice: "Gedalías"
decisions.reason: The usual Spanish form; Ahicam and Safán as in 22:12.

source.text: וַיִּשְׁמְעוּ֩ כָל־שָׂרֵ֨י הַחֲיָלִ֜ים הֵ֣מָּה וְהָאֲנָשִׁ֗ים כִּֽי־הִפְקִ֤יד מֶֽלֶךְ־בָּבֶל֙ אֶת־גְּדַלְיָ֔הוּ וַיָּבֹ֥אוּ אֶל־גְּדַלְיָ֖הוּ הַמִּצְפָּ֑ה וְיִשְׁמָעֵ֣אל בֶּן־נְתַנְיָ֡ה וְיוֹחָנָ֣ן בֶּן־קָ֠רֵחַ וּשְׂרָיָ֨ה בֶן־תַּנְחֻ֜מֶת הַנְּטֹפָתִ֗י וְיַֽאֲזַנְיָ֨הוּ֙ בֶּן־הַמַּ֣עֲכָתִ֔י הֵ֖מָּה וְאַנְשֵׁיהֶֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And heard all [the] commanders of the forces, they and the men, that had appointed [the] king of Babylon Gedaliah, and they came to Gedaliah [to] Mizpah: and Ishmael son of Nethaniah, and Johanan son of Kareah, and Seraiah son of Tanhumeth the Netophathite, and Jaazaniah son of the Maacathite, they and their men.

en.L: And all the commanders of the forces, they and the men, heard that the king of Babylon had appointed Gedaliah, and they came to Gedaliah at Mizpah: Ishmael son of Nethaniah, and Johanan son of Kareah, and Seraiah son of Tanhumeth the Netophathite, and Jaazaniah son of the Maacathite, they and their men.
en.B: All the commanders of the forces and their men learned that the king of Babylon had appointed Gedaliah, and they came to Gedaliah at Mizpah. They were Ishmael son of Nethaniah, Johanan son of Kareah, Seraiah son of Tanhumeth the Netophathite, and Jaazaniah son of the Maacathite, together with their men.
en.R: All the army commanders and their men heard that the king of Babylon had put Gedaliah in charge. So they came to Gedaliah at Mizpah. They were Ishmael son of Nethaniah, Johanan son of Kareah, Seraiah son of Tanhumeth from the town of Netophah, and Jaazaniah son of the Maacathite. Their men came with them.

es.L: Y oyeron todos los jefes de las tropas, ellos y sus hombres, que el rey de Babilonia había puesto a Gedalías, y vinieron a Gedalías [a] Mizpa: Ismael hijo de Netanías, y Johanán hijo de Carea, y Seraías hijo de Tanhumet el netofatita, y Jaazanías hijo del maacateo, ellos y sus hombres.
es.B: Todos los jefes de las tropas y sus hombres se enteraron de que el rey de Babilonia había nombrado a Gedalías, y fueron a ver a Gedalías en Mizpa. Eran Ismael hijo de Netanías, Johanán hijo de Carea, Seraías hijo de Tanhumet el netofatita y Jaazanías hijo del maacateo, junto con sus hombres.
es.R: Todos los jefes del ejército y sus hombres oyeron que el rey de Babilonia había puesto a Gedalías a cargo del país. Así que fueron a ver a Gedalías en Mizpa. Eran Ismael hijo de Netanías, Johanán hijo de Carea, Seraías hijo de Tanhumet, de la ciudad de Netofa, y Jaazanías hijo del maacateo. Sus hombres fueron con ellos.

fr.L: Et tous les chefs des troupes, eux et les hommes, apprirent que le roi de Babylone avait établi Guedalia, et ils vinrent auprès de Guedalia, à Mitspa : Ismaël fils de Netania, Yohanân fils de Qaréah, Seraya fils de Tanhoumeth le Netophatite, et Yaazania fils du Maakatite, eux et leurs hommes.
fr.B: Tous les chefs des troupes et leurs hommes apprirent que le roi de Babylone avait établi Guedalia, et ils vinrent le trouver à Mitspa. C’étaient Ismaël, fils de Netania, Yohanân, fils de Qaréah, Seraya, fils de Tanhoumeth, le Netophatite, et Yaazania, fils du Maakatite, avec leurs hommes.
fr.R: Tous les chefs de l’armée et leurs hommes ont appris que le roi de Babylone avait mis Guedalia à la tête du pays. Alors ils sont venus voir Guedalia à Mitspa. C’étaient Ismaël fils de Netania, Yohanân fils de Qaréah, Seraya fils de Tanhoumeth, de la ville de Netopha, et Yaazania fils du Maakatite. Leurs hommes sont venus avec eux.

sw.L: Nao wakuu wote wa majeshi, wao na watu, waliposikia kwamba mfalme wa Babeli amemweka Gedalia, wakaja kwa Gedalia huko Mizpa: Ishmaeli mwana wa Nethania, na Yohana mwana wa Karea, na Seraya mwana wa Tanhumethi Mnetofathi, na Yaazania mwana wa Mmaakathi, wao na watu wao.
sw.B: Wakuu wote wa majeshi na watu wao walisikia kwamba mfalme wa Babeli amemweka Gedalia, wakaja kwa Gedalia huko Mizpa. Hao walikuwa Ishmaeli mwana wa Nethania, Yohana mwana wa Karea, Seraya mwana wa Tanhumethi Mnetofathi, na Yaazania mwana wa Mmaakathi, pamoja na watu wao.
sw.R: Makamanda wote wa jeshi na watu wao walisikia kwamba mfalme wa Babeli amemweka Gedalia kuwa msimamizi. Kwa hiyo wakaja kwa Gedalia huko Mizpa. Hao walikuwa Ishmaeli mwana wa Nethania, Yohana mwana wa Karea, Seraya mwana wa Tanhumethi kutoka mji wa Netofa, na Yaazania mwana wa Mmaakathi. Watu wao walikuja pamoja nao.

vi.L: Tất cả các tướng chỉ huy quân lính, họ và người của họ, nghe rằng vua Ba-by-lôn đã lập Ghê-đa-lia, thì họ đến cùng Ghê-đa-lia tại Mích-ba: Ích-ma-ên con trai Nê-tha-nia, Giô-ha-nan con trai Ca-rê-át, Sê-ra-gia con trai Tan-hu-mết người Nê-tô-pha, và Gia-a-xa-nia con trai người Ma-a-ca, họ và người của họ.
vi.B: Tất cả các tướng chỉ huy quân lính và người của họ nghe tin vua Ba-by-lôn đã lập Ghê-đa-lia, nên họ đến gặp Ghê-đa-lia tại Mích-ba. Đó là Ích-ma-ên con trai Nê-tha-nia, Giô-ha-nan con trai Ca-rê-át, Sê-ra-gia con trai Tan-hu-mết người Nê-tô-pha, và Gia-a-xa-nia con trai người Ma-a-ca, cùng với người của họ.
vi.R: Tất cả các tướng chỉ huy và quân lính của họ nghe tin vua Ba-by-lôn đã giao cho Ghê-đa-lia cai quản. Vậy họ đến gặp Ghê-đa-lia tại Mích-ba. Đó là Ích-ma-ên con trai Nê-tha-nia, Giô-ha-nan con trai Ca-rê-át, Sê-ra-gia con trai Tan-hu-mết, người thành Nê-tô-pha, và Gia-a-xa-nia con trai người Ma-a-ca. Quân lính của họ cũng đi theo.

ko.L: 그리고 군대 지휘관들, 곧 그들과 그 부하들이 바빌론 왕이 그다랴를 세웠다는 소식을 듣고 미스바로 그다랴에게 왔다. 느다냐의 아들 이스마엘과 가레아의 아들 요하난과 느도바 사람 단후멧의 아들 스라야와 마아가 사람의 아들 야아사냐, 그들과 그들의 부하들이었다.
ko.B: 모든 군대 지휘관과 그들의 부하들은 바빌론 왕이 그다랴를 총독으로 세웠다는 소식을 듣고, 미스바로 그다랴를 찾아왔다. 그들은 느다냐의 아들 이스마엘, 가레아의 아들 요하난, 느도바 사람 단후멧의 아들 스라야, 마아가 사람의 아들 야아사냐와 그들의 부하들이었다.
ko.R: 모든 군대 지휘관과 그들의 부하들은 바빌론 왕이 그다랴에게 다스리는 일을 맡겼다는 소식을 들었다. 그래서 그들은 미스바로 그다랴를 찾아왔다. 그들은 느다냐의 아들 이스마엘, 가레아의 아들 요하난, 느도바 성읍 출신 단후멧의 아들 스라야, 마아가 사람의 아들 야아사냐였다. 그들의 부하들도 함께 왔다.

decisions.choice: the commanders of the forces: Judah's officers still at large
decisions.reason: These were officers of Judah's army who had not been captured and were still out in the countryside with their men (Jeremiah 40:7).

decisions.choice: Mizpah: a town of Benjamin north of Jerusalem
decisions.reason: Mizpah lay a few miles north of Jerusalem and had long been a gathering place for Israel (1 Samuel 7:5-6; 10:17). With Jerusalem in ruins, Gedaliah governed from there.

decisions.choice: the Netophathite; the Maacathite
decisions.reason: Netophah was a town near Bethlehem (Ezra 2:22; 2 Samuel 23:28). The Maacathites were a clan named for Maacah, a small Aramean region northeast of Galilee (Deuteronomy 3:14; 2 Samuel 23:34); Jaazaniah's father is named only by his clan.

decisions.choice: a fuller list in Jeremiah 40:7-8
decisions.reason: Jeremiah 40:8 also names Jonathan son of Kareah and the sons of Ephai the Netophathite, and spells Jaazaniah as Jezaniah.

decisions.choice: from the town of Netophah (Readable)
decisions.reason: Readable explains "the Netophathite" by naming his town.

decisions.choice: "Mizpa", "Ismael", "Netanías", "Johanán", "Carea", "Tanhumet", "netofatita", "Jaazanías", "maacateo"
decisions.reason: "Mizpa" as the Samuel terms note gives it; the other names in their usual Spanish forms.

source.text: וַיִּשָּׁבַ֨ע לָהֶ֤ם גְּדַלְיָ֨הוּ֙ וּלְאַנְשֵׁיהֶ֔ם וַיֹּ֣אמֶר לָהֶ֔ם אַל־תִּֽירְא֖וּ מֵעַבְדֵ֣י הַכַּשְׂדִּ֑ים שְׁב֣וּ בָאָ֗רֶץ וְעִבְד֛וּ אֶת־מֶ֥לֶךְ בָּבֶ֖ל וְיִטַ֥ב לָכֶֽם׃ס

records.literal_gloss: And swore to them Gedaliah and to their men, and said to them, Do not fear from [the] servants of the Chaldeans; dwell in the land and serve [the] king of Babylon, and it will be good for you.

en.L: And Gedaliah swore to them and to their men, and he said to them, "Do not be afraid of the servants of the Chaldeans. Dwell in the land and serve the king of Babylon, and it will be well with you."
en.B: Gedaliah swore an oath to them and their men. "Do not be afraid of the Chaldean officials," he said. "Settle in the land, serve the king of Babylon, and all will go well with you."
en.R: Gedaliah gave them and their men his promise, and he swore an oath to keep it. "Do not be afraid of the Babylonian officials," he said. "Stay in the land and serve the king of Babylon. Then things will go well for you."

es.L: Y Gedalías les juró a ellos y a sus hombres, y les dijo: «No {{plural_you:tengan|tengáis}} miedo de los siervos de los caldeos; {{plural_you:habiten|habitad}} en la tierra y {{plural_you:sirvan|servid}} al rey de Babilonia, y {{plural_you:les|os}} irá bien».
es.B: Gedalías les hizo un juramento a ellos y a sus hombres. «No {{plural_you:tengan|tengáis}} miedo de los funcionarios caldeos», les dijo. «{{plural_you:Quédense|Quedaos}} a vivir en la tierra, {{plural_you:sirvan|servid}} al rey de Babilonia, y todo {{plural_you:les|os}} irá bien».
es.R: Gedalías les hizo una promesa a ellos y a sus hombres, y juró que la cumpliría. «No {{plural_you:tengan|tengáis}} miedo de los funcionarios babilonios», les dijo. «{{plural_you:Quédense|Quedaos}} en el país y {{plural_you:sirvan|servid}} al rey de Babilonia. Así {{plural_you:les|os}} irá bien».

fr.L: Et Guedalia leur fit un serment, à eux et à leurs hommes, et il leur dit : « N’ayez pas peur des serviteurs des Chaldéens. Habitez dans le pays et servez le roi de Babylone, et vous vous en trouverez bien. »
fr.B: Guedalia leur fit un serment, à eux et à leurs hommes. « N’ayez pas peur des officiers chaldéens, leur dit-il. Restez dans le pays, servez le roi de Babylone, et tout ira bien pour vous. »
fr.R: Guedalia leur a fait une promesse, à eux et à leurs hommes, et il a juré de la tenir. « N’ayez pas peur des officiers babyloniens, leur a-t-il dit. Restez dans le pays et servez le roi de Babylone. Alors tout ira bien pour vous. »

sw.L: Naye Gedalia akawaapia wao na watu wao, akawaambia, "Msiwaogope watumishi wa Wakaldayo. Kaeni katika nchi, mtumikieni mfalme wa Babeli, nanyi mtakuwa salama."
sw.B: Gedalia aliwaapia wao na watu wao. Akasema, "Msiwaogope maafisa wa Wakaldayo. Kaeni katika nchi, mtumikieni mfalme wa Babeli, nanyi mtafanikiwa."
sw.R: Gedalia aliwapa wao na watu wao ahadi, akaapa kwamba ataitimiza. Akasema, "Msiwaogope maafisa wa Babeli. Kaeni katika nchi na kumtumikia mfalme wa Babeli. Ndipo mambo yatawaendea vizuri."

vi.L: Ghê-đa-lia thề với họ và với người của họ, và nói với họ: "Đừng sợ các đầy tớ của người Canh-đê. Hãy ở lại trong xứ và phục vụ vua Ba-by-lôn, thì các ông sẽ được yên ổn."
vi.B: Ghê-đa-lia thề với họ và người của họ. Ông nói: "Đừng sợ các quan chức người Canh-đê. Hãy ở lại trong xứ, phục vụ vua Ba-by-lôn, thì mọi việc sẽ tốt đẹp cho các ông."
vi.R: Ghê-đa-lia hứa với họ và người của họ, và ông thề sẽ giữ lời. Ông nói: "Đừng sợ các quan chức Ba-by-lôn. Hãy ở lại trong xứ và phục vụ vua Ba-by-lôn. Như vậy mọi việc sẽ tốt đẹp cho các ông."

ko.L: 그리고 그다랴가 그들과 그들의 부하들에게 맹세하며 그들에게 말했다. "갈대아 사람들의 신하들을 두려워하지 마시오. 이 땅에 살면서 바빌론 왕을 섬기시오. 그러면 여러분이 잘될 것이오."
ko.B: 그다랴는 그들과 그들의 부하들에게 맹세하며 말했다. "갈대아 관리들을 두려워하지 마시오. 이 땅에 자리 잡고 바빌론 왕을 섬기시오. 그러면 여러분이 모두 잘될 것이오."
ko.R: 그다랴는 그들과 그들의 부하들에게 약속하고, 그 약속을 지키겠다고 맹세했다. 그가 말했다. "바빌로니아 관리들을 두려워하지 마시오. 이 땅에 머물며 바빌론 왕을 섬기시오. 그러면 여러분에게 좋은 일이 있을 것이오."

decisions.choice: swore to them: gave his word under oath
decisions.reason: Gedaliah guaranteed with an oath that the commanders and their men would be safe if they accepted Babylonian rule.

decisions.choice: the servants of the Chaldeans: the Babylonian officials
decisions.reason: The "servants" are the officers who governed for Babylon. Jeremiah 40:9 has instead "Do not be afraid to serve the Chaldeans".

decisions.choice: the counsel Jeremiah had given
decisions.reason: Gedaliah repeats the message Jeremiah had long given: serve the king of Babylon and live (Jeremiah 27:11-12; 38:17), settle where you are and seek its good (Jeremiah 29:4-7). Jeremiah 40:9-10 gives Gedaliah's words more fully.

decisions.choice: servants (Literal); officials (Balanced and Readable)
decisions.reason: As in verse 8.

decisions.choice: he said, placed inside the speech (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable put "he said" after the first sentence of the speech, so the oath and the words are not joined by a long run of "and". Readable says what the oath was for.

decisions.choice: {{plural_you:tengan|tengáis}}
decisions.reason: Gedaliah speaks to the commanders and their men together, so every "you" carries the plural_you setting.

decisions.choice: Gedaliah to the commanders: các ông
decisions.reason: Gedaliah, a governor speaking to army commanders who are not his subjects, uses the respectful "các ông".

decisions.choice: Gedaliah speaks to the army commanders in 하오체 with "여러분"
decisions.reason: A governor appointed by Babylon addressing Judah's own officers: he has authority but must win their trust, so neither the plain style nor deference fits.

source.text: וַיְהִ֣י׀בַּחֹ֣דֶשׁ הַשְּׁבִיעִ֗י בָּ֣א יִשְׁמָעֵ֣אל בֶּן־נְ֠תַנְיָה בֶּן־אֱלִ֨ישָׁמָ֜ע מִזֶּ֣רַע הַמְּלוּכָ֗ה וַעֲשָׂרָ֤ה אֲנָשִׁים֙ אִתּ֔וֹ וַיַּכּ֥וּ אֶת־גְּדַלְיָ֖הוּ וַיָּמֹ֑ת וְאֶת־הַיְּהוּדִים֙ וְאֶת־הַכַּשְׂדִּ֔ים אֲשֶׁר־הָי֥וּ אִתּ֖וֹ בַּמִּצְפָּֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And it was in the month the seventh, came Ishmael son of Nethaniah son of Elishama, of [the] seed of the kingship, and ten men with him, and they struck Gedaliah and he died, and the Judeans and the Chaldeans who were with him at Mizpah.

en.L: And it came about in the seventh month [that] Ishmael son of Nethaniah son of Elishama, of the royal seed, came, and ten men with him, and they struck Gedaliah, and he died, and the Judeans and the Chaldeans who were with him at Mizpah.
en.B: But in the seventh month Ishmael son of Nethaniah, son of Elishama, who was of royal descent, came with ten men and struck down Gedaliah and killed him, together with the Judeans and the Chaldeans who were with him at Mizpah.
en.R: But in the seventh month, Ishmael son of Nethaniah and grandson of Elishama came to Mizpah with ten men. Ishmael was a member of the royal family. He and his men attacked and killed Gedaliah. They also killed the Judeans and the Babylonians who were with Gedaliah at Mizpah.

es.L: Y sucedió en el mes séptimo [que] vino Ismael hijo de Netanías, hijo de Elisama, de la descendencia real, y diez hombres con él, e hirieron a Gedalías, y murió, y a los judíos y a los caldeos que estaban con él en Mizpa.
es.B: Pero en el mes séptimo, Ismael hijo de Netanías, hijo de Elisama, que era de sangre real, vino con diez hombres, atacó a Gedalías y lo mató, junto con los judíos y los caldeos que estaban con él en Mizpa.
es.R: Pero en el mes séptimo, Ismael hijo de Netanías y nieto de Elisama llegó a Mizpa con diez hombres. Ismael era de la familia real. Él y sus hombres atacaron a Gedalías y lo mataron. También mataron a los judíos y a los babilonios que estaban con Gedalías en Mizpa.

fr.L: Et il arriva au septième mois [qu’]Ismaël fils de Netania fils d’Élishama, de la descendance royale, vint, et dix hommes avec lui, et ils frappèrent Guedalia, et il mourut, ainsi que les Judéens et les Chaldéens qui étaient avec lui à Mitspa.
fr.B: Mais au septième mois, Ismaël, fils de Netania, fils d’Élishama, qui était de descendance royale, vint avec dix hommes ; ils abattirent Guedalia et le tuèrent, ainsi que les Judéens et les Chaldéens qui étaient avec lui à Mitspa.
fr.R: Mais au septième mois, Ismaël fils de Netania et petit-fils d’Élishama est venu à Mitspa avec dix hommes. Ismaël faisait partie de la famille royale. Avec ses hommes, il a attaqué Guedalia et l’a tué. Ils ont aussi tué les Judéens et les Babyloniens qui étaient avec Guedalia à Mitspa.

sw.L: Ikawa katika mwezi wa saba, Ishmaeli mwana wa Nethania mwana wa Elishama, wa uzao wa kifalme, akaja, na watu kumi pamoja naye, wakampiga Gedalia, naye akafa, na Wayahudi na Wakaldayo waliokuwa pamoja naye huko Mizpa.
sw.B: Lakini katika mwezi wa saba Ishmaeli mwana wa Nethania, mwana wa Elishama, aliyekuwa wa ukoo wa kifalme, alikuja na watu kumi, wakampiga Gedalia, akafa, pamoja na Wayahudi na Wakaldayo waliokuwa pamoja naye huko Mizpa.
sw.R: Lakini katika mwezi wa saba, Ishmaeli mwana wa Nethania na mjukuu wa Elishama alikuja Mizpa pamoja na watu kumi. Ishmaeli alikuwa mtu wa ukoo wa kifalme. Yeye na watu wake walimshambulia Gedalia, wakamwua. Waliwaua pia Wayahudi na Wababeli waliokuwa pamoja na Gedalia huko Mizpa.

vi.L: Xảy ra vào tháng thứ bảy, Ích-ma-ên con trai Nê-tha-nia, con trai Ê-li-sa-ma, thuộc dòng dõi hoàng gia, đến cùng mười người, và họ đánh Ghê-đa-lia, và ông chết, cùng với người Giu-đa và người Canh-đê ở với ông tại Mích-ba.
vi.B: Nhưng đến tháng bảy, Ích-ma-ên con trai Nê-tha-nia, cháu Ê-li-sa-ma, thuộc dòng dõi hoàng gia, cùng mười người đến tấn công và giết Ghê-đa-lia, cùng với những người Giu-đa và người Canh-đê ở với ông tại Mích-ba.
vi.R: Nhưng vào tháng bảy, Ích-ma-ên con trai Nê-tha-nia và cháu nội Ê-li-sa-ma đến Mích-ba với mười người. Ích-ma-ên thuộc hoàng tộc. Hắn và người của hắn tấn công và giết Ghê-đa-lia. Chúng cũng giết những người Giu-đa và người Ba-by-lôn đang ở với Ghê-đa-lia tại Mích-ba.

ko.L: 그리고 일곱째 달에 왕족의 씨인 엘리사마의 손자 느다냐의 아들 이스마엘이 열 사람과 함께 와서, 그다랴를 쳐서 그가 죽었다. 미스바에서 그와 함께 있던 유다 사람들과 갈대아 사람들도 [쳤다].
ko.B: 그러나 일곱째 달에 왕족 출신인 엘리사마의 손자요 느다냐의 아들인 이스마엘이 열 사람을 데리고 와서, 그다랴를 쳐 죽이고, 미스바에서 그와 함께 있던 유다 사람들과 갈대아 사람들도 죽였다.
ko.R: 그러나 일곱째 달에 느다냐의 아들이며 엘리사마의 손자인 이스마엘이 열 사람을 데리고 미스바로 왔다. 이스마엘은 왕족이었다. 그와 그의 부하들은 그다랴를 공격하여 죽였다. 그들은 미스바에서 그다랴와 함께 있던 유다 사람들과 바빌로니아 사람들도 죽였다.

decisions.choice: the seventh month: autumn, probably of the same year
decisions.reason: No year is given here or in Jeremiah 41:1. It is usually taken to be the same year, two months after the temple was burned. Some think it was a later year, since Jeremiah 52:30 mentions another deportation five years later.

decisions.choice: of the royal seed: a member of the family of David
decisions.reason: Ishmael belonged to the royal line and may have resented a governor from outside it who served Babylon. Jeremiah 40:14 says that Baalis king of Ammon had sent him to kill Gedaliah.

decisions.choice: the murder later mourned with a fast
decisions.reason: "The fast of the seventh month" is named beside the fasts of the fourth, fifth and tenth months (Zechariah 7:5; 8:19), which match the dates in verses 1, 3 and 8. In Jewish tradition it is kept as the fast of Gedaliah.

decisions.choice: told at length in Jeremiah 41:1-3
decisions.reason: Jeremiah 41:1-3 adds that Ishmael and his men ate a meal with Gedaliah at Mizpah before killing him, and that the dead included the soldiers there.

decisions.choice: grandson of Elishama; They also killed (Readable); and killed him (Balanced)
decisions.reason: "Son of Nethaniah son of Elishama" names his father and grandfather, and Readable says so. Balanced and Readable spell out that the Judeans and the Chaldeans were killed too, which the Hebrew implies by joining them to "they struck".

decisions.choice: "Elisama"; "los judíos"
decisions.reason: Here, after the fall of the kingdom, "los judíos" names the people of Judah with Gedaliah, as the English "Judeans" does at every level.

source.text: וַיָּקֻ֨מוּ כָל־הָעָ֜ם מִקָּטֹ֤ן וְעַד־גָּדוֹל֙ וְשָׂרֵ֣י הַחֲיָלִ֔ים וַיָּבֹ֖אוּ מִצְרָ֑יִם כִּ֥י יָרְא֖וּ מִפְּנֵ֥י כַשְׂדִּֽים׃פ

records.literal_gloss: And arose all the people, from small and to great, and [the] commanders of the forces, and they went [to] Egypt, for they were afraid from [the] face of [the] Chaldeans.

en.L: And all the people, from small to great, and the commanders of the forces arose and went [to] Egypt, because they were afraid of the Chaldeans.
en.B: Then all the people, from the least to the greatest, and the commanders of the forces set out and went to Egypt, because they were afraid of the Chaldeans.
en.R: Then all the people, from the least important to the most important, left with the army commanders and went to Egypt. They were afraid of what the Babylonians would do to them.

es.L: Y se levantó todo el pueblo, desde el más pequeño hasta el más grande, y los jefes de las tropas, y fueron [a] Egipto, porque tenían miedo de los caldeos.
es.B: Entonces todo el pueblo, desde el más pequeño hasta el más grande, y los jefes de las tropas se pusieron en camino y se fueron a Egipto, porque tenían miedo de los caldeos.
es.R: Entonces todo el pueblo, desde el menos importante hasta el más importante, se fue con los jefes del ejército a Egipto. Tenían miedo de lo que los babilonios pudieran hacerles.

fr.L: Et tout le peuple, du plus petit au plus grand, et les chefs des troupes se levèrent et allèrent [en] Égypte, car ils avaient peur des Chaldéens.
fr.B: Alors tout le peuple, du plus petit au plus grand, et les chefs des troupes partirent pour l’Égypte, car ils avaient peur des Chaldéens.
fr.R: Alors tout le peuple, des plus humbles aux plus importants, est parti avec les chefs de l’armée, et ils sont allés en Égypte. Ils avaient peur de ce que les Babyloniens allaient leur faire.

sw.L: Nao watu wote, wadogo kwa wakubwa, na wakuu wa majeshi, wakaondoka, wakaenda [hata] Misri, kwa sababu waliwaogopa Wakaldayo.
sw.B: Kisha watu wote, tangu mdogo hadi mkubwa, pamoja na wakuu wa majeshi, waliondoka, wakaenda Misri, kwa sababu waliwaogopa Wakaldayo.
sw.R: Kisha watu wote, tangu wasio na cheo hadi wenye vyeo vikubwa, waliondoka pamoja na makamanda wa jeshi, wakaenda Misri. Waliogopa yale ambayo Wababeli wangewatendea.

vi.L: Toàn dân, từ nhỏ đến lớn, và các tướng chỉ huy quân lính, đứng dậy và đi [đến] Ai Cập, vì họ sợ người Canh-đê.
vi.B: Bấy giờ toàn dân, từ người nhỏ nhất đến người lớn nhất, cùng các tướng chỉ huy quân lính, ra đi sang Ai Cập, vì họ sợ người Canh-đê.
vi.R: Bấy giờ toàn dân, từ người thấp hèn nhất đến người quan trọng nhất, cùng với các tướng chỉ huy bỏ đi sang Ai Cập. Họ sợ quân Ba-by-lôn sẽ trả thù họ.

ko.L: 그리고 작은 자부터 큰 자까지 모든 백성과 군대 지휘관들이 일어나 이집트로 갔다. 그들이 갈대아 사람들의 얼굴을 두려워했기 때문이다.
ko.B: 그러자 낮은 자에서 높은 자까지 모든 백성과 군대 지휘관들이 일어나 이집트로 갔다. 그들이 갈대아 사람들을 두려워했기 때문이다.
ko.R: 그러자 지위가 낮은 사람부터 높은 사람까지 모든 백성이 군대 지휘관들과 함께 떠나 이집트로 갔다. 그들은 바빌로니아 사람들이 자기들에게 무슨 일을 할까 봐 두려웠다.

decisions.choice: from small to great: everyone, whatever their rank or age
decisions.reason: The pair takes in the whole people, from the least important to the most important (Jeremiah 6:13; 42:1).

decisions.choice: afraid of the face of the Chaldeans: afraid of what they would do
decisions.reason: They feared that Babylon would punish them all for the murder of its governor and its soldiers (Jeremiah 41:18).

decisions.choice: the flight to Egypt told in Jeremiah 42-43
decisions.reason: Jeremiah told them in the LORD's name to stay in the land and not go to Egypt (Jeremiah 42:9-19), but they went anyway and took him with them (Jeremiah 43:1-7). After the story of the exodus, the people's return to Egypt undoes their deliverance, as Deuteronomy 28:68 had warned.

decisions.choice: afraid of what the Babylonians would do to them (Readable)
decisions.reason: Readable explains the idiom and joins the people to the commanders with "left with".

source.text: וַיְהִי֩ בִשְׁלֹשִׁ֨ים וָשֶׁ֜בַע שָׁנָ֗ה לְגָלוּת֙ יְהוֹיָכִ֣ין מֶֽלֶךְ־יְהוּדָ֔ה בִּשְׁנֵ֤ים עָשָׂר֙ חֹ֔דֶשׁ בְּעֶשְׂרִ֥ים וְשִׁבְעָ֖ה לַחֹ֑דֶשׁ נָשָׂ֡א אֱוִ֣יל מְרֹדַךְ֩ מֶ֨לֶךְ בָּבֶ֜ל בִּשְׁנַ֣ת מָלְכ֗וֹ אֶת־רֹ֛אשׁ יְהוֹיָכִ֥ין מֶֽלֶךְ־יְהוּדָ֖ה מִבֵּ֥ית כֶּֽלֶא׃

records.literal_gloss: And it was in [the] thirty and seven year of [the] exile of Jehoiachin king of Judah, in [the] twelfth month, on [the] twenty and seven of the month, lifted Evil-Merodach king of Babylon, in [the] year of his reigning, [the] head of Jehoiachin king of Judah from [the] house of imprisonment.

en.L: And it came about in the thirty-seventh year of the exile of Jehoiachin king of Judah, in the twelfth month, on the twenty-seventh [day] of the month, [that] Evil-Merodach king of Babylon, in the year he became king, lifted up the head of Jehoiachin king of Judah from the house of imprisonment.
en.B: In the thirty-seventh year of the exile of Jehoiachin king of Judah, on the twenty-seventh day of the twelfth month, Evil-Merodach king of Babylon, in the year he became king, showed favor to Jehoiachin king of Judah and released him from prison.
en.R: Jehoiachin king of Judah had been in exile for thirty-seven years. Then Evil-Merodach became king of Babylon. In the year he became king, on the twenty-seventh day of the twelfth month, he showed Jehoiachin favor and let him out of prison.

es.L: Y sucedió en el año treinta y siete del cautiverio de Joaquín, rey de Judá, en el mes duodécimo, a los veintisiete [días] del mes, [que] Evil-merodac, rey de Babilonia, en el año en que comenzó a reinar, levantó la cabeza de Joaquín, rey de Judá, de la casa de la prisión.
es.B: En el año treinta y siete del destierro de Joaquín, rey de Judá, el día veintisiete del mes duodécimo, Evil-merodac, rey de Babilonia, en el año en que comenzó a reinar, le mostró su favor a Joaquín, rey de Judá, y lo sacó de la cárcel.
es.R: Joaquín, rey de Judá, llevaba treinta y siete años en el destierro. Entonces Evil-merodac llegó a ser rey de Babilonia. En el año en que comenzó a reinar, el día veintisiete del mes duodécimo, le mostró su favor a Joaquín y lo sacó de la cárcel.

fr.L: Et il arriva, la trente-septième année de l’exil de Joïakin, roi de Juda, au douzième mois, le vingt-sept du mois, [qu’]Évil-Merodak, roi de Babylone, l’année où il devint roi, releva la tête de Joïakin, roi de Juda, [et le fit sortir] de la maison de détention.
fr.B: La trente-septième année de l’exil de Joïakin, roi de Juda, le vingt-sept du douzième mois, Évil-Merodak, roi de Babylone, l’année même où il devint roi, accorda sa faveur à Joïakin, roi de Juda, et le fit sortir de prison.
fr.R: Joïakin, roi de Juda, était en exil depuis trente-sept ans. Alors Évil-Merodak est devenu roi de Babylone. L’année où il est devenu roi, le vingt-sept du douzième mois, il a été bon pour Joïakin et l’a fait sortir de prison.

sw.L: Ikawa katika mwaka wa thelathini na saba wa uhamisho wa Yehoyakini mfalme wa Yuda, katika mwezi wa kumi na mbili, siku ya ishirini na saba ya mwezi, Evil-merodaki mfalme wa Babeli, katika mwaka alioanza kutawala, akakiinua kichwa cha Yehoyakini mfalme wa Yuda kutoka katika nyumba ya kifungo.
sw.B: Katika mwaka wa thelathini na saba wa uhamisho wa Yehoyakini mfalme wa Yuda, siku ya ishirini na saba ya mwezi wa kumi na mbili, Evil-merodaki mfalme wa Babeli, katika mwaka alioanza kutawala, alimwonyesha Yehoyakini mfalme wa Yuda fadhili, akamtoa gerezani.
sw.R: Yehoyakini mfalme wa Yuda alikuwa amekaa uhamishoni kwa miaka thelathini na saba. Kisha Evil-merodaki akawa mfalme wa Babeli. Katika mwaka alioanza kutawala, siku ya ishirini na saba ya mwezi wa kumi na mbili, alimwonyesha Yehoyakini fadhili, akamtoa gerezani.

vi.L: Xảy ra vào năm thứ ba mươi bảy kể từ khi Giê-hô-gia-kin vua Giu-đa bị lưu đày, tháng thứ mười hai, ngày hai mươi bảy trong tháng, Ê-vinh-Mê-rô-đác vua Ba-by-lôn, trong năm vua ấy lên ngôi, ngẩng đầu Giê-hô-gia-kin vua Giu-đa lên [và đưa] ra khỏi ngục.
vi.B: Năm thứ ba mươi bảy kể từ khi Giê-hô-gia-kin vua Giu-đa bị lưu đày, vào ngày hai mươi bảy tháng mười hai, Ê-vinh-Mê-rô-đác vua Ba-by-lôn, trong năm mới lên ngôi, đã ban ơn cho Giê-hô-gia-kin vua Giu-đa và thả ông ra khỏi ngục.
vi.R: Giê-hô-gia-kin vua Giu-đa đã bị lưu đày ba mươi bảy năm. Bấy giờ Ê-vinh-Mê-rô-đác lên làm vua Ba-by-lôn. Trong năm lên ngôi, vào ngày hai mươi bảy tháng mười hai, vua ấy ban ơn cho Giê-hô-gia-kin và thả ông ra khỏi ngục.

ko.L: 그리고 유다 왕 여호야긴이 사로잡혀 간 지 삼십칠 년째 되는 해 열두째 달 이십칠일에, 바빌론 왕 에윌므로닥이 왕이 된 그해에 유다 왕 여호야긴의 머리를 들어 감옥에서 [나오게 했다].
ko.B: 유다 왕 여호야긴이 사로잡혀 간 지 삼십칠 년째 되는 해 열두째 달 이십칠일에, 바빌론 왕 에윌므로닥이 왕이 된 그해에 유다 왕 여호야긴에게 은혜를 베풀어 그를 감옥에서 풀어 주었다.
ko.R: 유다 왕 여호야긴이 포로로 잡혀간 지 삼십칠 년이 되었다. 그때 에윌므로닥이 바빌론의 왕이 되었다. 그는 왕이 된 그해 열두째 달 이십칠일에 여호야긴에게 은혜를 베풀어 그를 감옥에서 풀어 주었다.

decisions.choice: lifted up the head: showed favor and released
decisions.reason: To lift up someone's head is to raise him from disgrace to favor, as Pharaoh lifted up the head of his cupbearer and brought him out of prison (Genesis 40:13, 20). Here it goes with release "from the house of imprisonment".

decisions.choice: Evil-Merodach: the Babylonian king Awel-Marduk
decisions.reason: The name is the Hebrew form of Awel-Marduk, "man of Marduk", Nebuchadnezzar's son, who reigned for about two years. In Hebrew the first part sounds like the word for "foolish", which may be no more than the way the name was heard, or a scornful twist.

decisions.choice: the thirty-seventh year: about 561 BC
decisions.reason: Jehoiachin was taken to Babylon at eighteen, in 597 BC (24:8-15). Thirty-seven years later, in the year Evil-Merodach came to the throne, he was about fifty-five. The twelfth month falls at the end of winter.

decisions.choice: Jeremiah 52:31: the twenty-fifth day
decisions.reason: Jeremiah 52:31 has the same sentence but dates the release to the twenty-fifth of the month, not the twenty-seventh. The difference may come from copying, or from counting the order and the release separately.

decisions.choice: showed favor ... and released him (Balanced); showed Jehoiachin favor and let him out (Readable)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable give both sides of the idiom with two verbs instead of keeping the picture of lifting the head. Readable splits the date into short sentences.

decisions.choice: "levantó la cabeza de Joaquín" (L); "le mostró su favor ... y lo sacó de la cárcel" (B, R); "Evil-merodac"
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew picture; Balanced and Readable give both sides of it with two verbs (m1). "Evil-merodac" as the terms note's table gives it.

decisions.choice: "releva la tête" (L); "accorda sa faveur ... et le fit sortir de prison" (B); "a été bon pour ... et l'a fait sortir de prison" (R)
decisions.reason: The idiom means showing favor and releasing (m1); Literal keeps the picture, and the other levels give its sense, as the English does. Évil-Merodak is the terms note's form.

decisions.choice: akakiinua kichwa cha Yehoyakini
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew "lifted up the head", to show favor and release (meaning decision m1).

decisions.choice: ngẩng đầu ... lên [và đưa] ra khỏi ngục (L)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew picture of lifting the head, and supplies in brackets the release it implies; Balanced and Readable give both sides with two verbs, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "머리를 들어" (L); "은혜를 베풀어 ... 풀어 주었다" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew idiom for showing favor; Balanced and Readable say what it means, as the English does.

source.text: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר אִתּ֖וֹ טֹב֑וֹת וַיִּתֵּן֙ אֶת־כִּסְא֔וֹ מֵעַ֗ל כִּסֵּ֧א הַמְּלָכִ֛ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר אִתּ֖וֹ בְּבָבֶֽל׃

records.literal_gloss: And he spoke with him good things, and set his seat above [the] seat of the kings who [were] with him in Babylon.

en.L: And he spoke good things with him and set his seat above the seat of the kings who [were] with him in Babylon.
en.B: He spoke kindly to him and gave him a seat of honor above the seats of the other kings who were with him in Babylon.
en.R: He spoke kindly to Jehoiachin and gave him a place of honor, higher than that of the other kings who were with him in Babylon.

es.L: Y le habló cosas buenas, y puso su asiento por encima del asiento de los reyes que [estaban] con él en Babilonia.
es.B: Le habló con bondad y le dio un asiento de honor por encima de los asientos de los demás reyes que estaban con él en Babilonia.
es.R: Le habló con bondad a Joaquín y le dio un lugar de honor, más alto que el de los demás reyes que estaban con él en Babilonia.

fr.L: Et il lui parla avec bonté, et il plaça son siège au-dessus du siège des rois qui [étaient] avec lui à Babylone.
fr.B: Il lui parla avec bienveillance et lui donna une place d’honneur au-dessus de celle des autres rois qui étaient avec lui à Babylone.
fr.R: Il a parlé gentiment à Joïakin et lui a donné une place d’honneur, plus haute que celle des autres rois qui étaient avec lui à Babylone.

sw.L: Naye akasema naye mambo mema, akakiweka kiti chake juu ya kiti cha wafalme waliokuwa pamoja naye huko Babeli.
sw.B: Alizungumza naye kwa wema, akampa kiti cha heshima juu ya viti vya wafalme wengine waliokuwa pamoja naye huko Babeli.
sw.R: Alizungumza na Yehoyakini kwa wema, akampa nafasi ya heshima, ya juu kuliko ya wafalme wengine waliokuwa pamoja naye huko Babeli.

vi.L: Vua ấy nói những lời tốt đẹp với ông và đặt ngai ông cao hơn ngai của các vua ở với vua ấy tại Ba-by-lôn.
vi.B: Vua ấy nói năng tử tế với ông và cho ông một chỗ ngồi danh dự, cao hơn chỗ ngồi của các vua khác ở với vua ấy tại Ba-by-lôn.
vi.R: Vua ấy nói năng tử tế với Giê-hô-gia-kin và cho ông một chỗ danh dự, cao hơn chỗ của các vua khác ở với vua ấy tại Ba-by-lôn.

ko.L: 그리고 그가 그와 좋은 말을 나누고, 그의 자리를 바빌론에서 그와 함께 있던 왕들의 자리보다 높이 두었다.
ko.B: 그는 여호야긴에게 친절하게 말하고, 바빌론에서 그와 함께 있던 다른 왕들의 자리보다 높은 영예로운 자리를 주었다.
ko.R: 그는 여호야긴에게 친절하게 말했다. 그리고 바빌론에서 그와 함께 지내던 다른 왕들보다 더 높은 명예로운 자리를 그에게 주었다.

decisions.choice: spoke good things with him: spoke kindly to him
decisions.reason: To speak "good things" is to speak kindly and favorably (Jeremiah 12:6). It may also suggest that the king promised him good treatment, as a ruler gives terms to one he has taken under his protection.

decisions.choice: the seat above the other kings: first place among the captive kings
decisions.reason: The Babylonian kings kept rulers of conquered lands at their court. Jehoiachin was given a seat higher than all of them, a public sign of honor.

decisions.choice: who were with him: with Jehoiachin or with the king
decisions.reason: "Him" may be Jehoiachin, the kings who were held with him, or Evil-Merodach, the kings at his court. The sense is the same: the other kings in Babylon.

decisions.choice: the same words in Jeremiah 52:32
decisions.reason: Jeremiah 52:32 has the same sentence.

decisions.choice: a seat of honor; a place of honor (Readable)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say what setting his seat above the others meant, and add "other" for the kings.

source.text: וְשִׁנָּ֕א אֵ֖ת בִּגְדֵ֣י כִלְא֑וֹ וְאָכַ֨ל לֶ֧חֶם תָּמִ֛יד לְפָנָ֖יו כָּל־יְמֵ֥י חַיָּֽיו׃

records.literal_gloss: And he changed [the] clothes of his imprisonment, and he ate bread continually before him all [the] days of his life.

en.L: And he changed his prison clothes, and he ate bread continually before him all the days of his life.
en.B: So Jehoiachin put off his prison clothes, and for the rest of his life he ate regularly at the king's table.
en.R: Jehoiachin no longer had to wear prison clothes. For the rest of his life he ate his meals at the king's table.

es.L: Y cambió sus vestidos de prisión, y comió pan continuamente delante de él todos los días de su vida.
es.B: Así Joaquín se quitó la ropa de prisionero, y por el resto de su vida comió siempre a la mesa del rey.
es.R: Joaquín ya no tuvo que usar ropa de prisionero. Por el resto de su vida comió a la mesa del rey.

fr.L: Et il changea ses vêtements de prison, et il mangea le pain continuellement devant lui, tous les jours de sa vie.
fr.B: Joïakin quitta ses vêtements de prisonnier, et tout le reste de sa vie il mangea régulièrement à la table du roi.
fr.R: Joïakin n’a plus eu à porter des vêtements de prisonnier. Jusqu’à la fin de sa vie, il a pris ses repas à la table du roi.

sw.L: Naye akabadilisha mavazi yake ya kifungo, akala chakula daima mbele yake siku zote za maisha yake.
sw.B: Basi Yehoyakini akayavua mavazi yake ya gerezani, na kwa maisha yake yote yaliyobaki akala daima mezani pa mfalme.
sw.R: Yehoyakini hakuvaa tena mavazi ya gerezani. Kwa maisha yake yote yaliyobaki alikula chakula chake mezani pa mfalme.

vi.L: Ông thay áo tù, và ông ăn bánh thường xuyên trước mặt vua ấy mọi ngày trong đời ông.
vi.B: Vậy Giê-hô-gia-kin cởi bỏ áo tù, và suốt quãng đời còn lại ông thường xuyên ăn tại bàn vua.
vi.R: Giê-hô-gia-kin không còn phải mặc áo tù nữa. Suốt quãng đời còn lại, ông được ăn uống tại bàn của vua.

ko.L: 그리고 그가 그의 죄수복을 갈아입었고, 그의 평생 동안 늘 그 앞에서 빵을 먹었다.
ko.B: 그래서 여호야긴은 죄수복을 벗었고, 평생 동안 늘 왕의 식탁에서 먹었다.
ko.R: 여호야긴은 더 이상 죄수복을 입지 않아도 되었다. 그는 죽을 때까지 왕의 식탁에서 함께 먹었다.

decisions.choice: he changed: Jehoiachin changed his clothes
alternatives: the king changed his prison clothes
decisions.reason: The subject is most likely Jehoiachin, who put off his prison clothes; it could also be the king, who had them changed. Either way his time as a prisoner was over.

decisions.choice: ate bread before him: ate at the king's table
decisions.reason: To eat at the king's table was a mark of honor and of provision for life, as David gave Jonathan's son Mephibosheth (2 Samuel 9:7, 13) and the sons of Barzillai (1 Kings 2:7).

decisions.choice: all the days of his life: until Jehoiachin died
decisions.reason: The phrase looks to Jehoiachin's own life, and is repeated in verse 30. Jeremiah 52:33 has the same sentence.

decisions.choice: Jehoiachin; at the king's table (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable name Jehoiachin and say "at the king's table" for "before him".

source.text: וַאֲרֻחָת֗וֹ אֲרֻחַ֨ת תָּמִ֧יד נִתְּנָה־לּ֛וֹ מֵאֵ֥ת הַמֶּ֖לֶךְ דְּבַר־י֣וֹם בְּיוֹמ֑וֹ כֹּ֖ל יְמֵ֥י חַיָּֽו׃

records.literal_gloss: And his allowance, an allowance continual, was given to him from with the king, [a] matter of [a] day in its day, all [the] days of his life.

en.L: And his allowance, a regular allowance, was given to him by the king, a day's portion each day, all the days of his life.
en.B: And the king gave him a regular allowance, a portion for each day, all the days of his life.
en.R: Every day the king gave him what he needed for that day, for the rest of his life.

es.L: Y su ración, una ración continua, le fue dada de parte del rey, la porción de cada día en su día, todos los días de su vida.
es.B: Y el rey le dio una ración fija, una porción para cada día, todos los días de su vida.
es.R: Cada día el rey le daba lo que necesitaba para ese día, por el resto de su vida.

fr.L: Et son entretien, un entretien continuel, lui fut donné de la part du roi, la ration de chaque jour en son jour, tous les jours de sa vie.
fr.B: Et le roi lui assura un entretien régulier, une portion pour chaque jour, tous les jours de sa vie.
fr.R: Chaque jour, le roi lui donnait ce dont il avait besoin pour la journée, et cela jusqu’à la fin de sa vie.

sw.L: Na posho lake, posho la daima, alipewa na mfalme, kiasi cha siku kwa siku yake, siku zote za maisha yake.
sw.B: Naye mfalme akampa posho la daima, sehemu ya kila siku, siku zote za maisha yake.
sw.R: Kila siku mfalme alimpa mahitaji yake ya siku hiyo, kwa maisha yake yote yaliyobaki.

vi.L: Phần lương của ông, một phần lương thường xuyên, được vua cấp cho ông, mỗi ngày một phần, mọi ngày trong đời ông.
vi.B: Vua cấp cho ông một phần lương thường xuyên, mỗi ngày một phần, suốt đời ông.
vi.R: Mỗi ngày vua cấp cho ông những gì ông cần dùng trong ngày ấy, suốt quãng đời còn lại của ông.

ko.L: 그리고 그의 생활비, 곧 끊이지 않는 생활비가 왕에게서 그에게 주어졌는데, 날마다 그날의 몫이 그의 평생 동안 [주어졌다].
ko.B: 그리고 왕은 그에게 정기적으로 생활비를 주었는데, 그의 평생 동안 날마다 그날의 몫을 주었다.
ko.R: 왕은 그가 사는 동안 날마다 그날 필요한 것을 그에게 주었다.

decisions.choice: a day's portion each day: a daily share
decisions.reason: The phrase is used of a daily quota or ration (Exodus 5:13; 16:4). The king provided for him day by day.

decisions.choice: the allowance: royal rations
decisions.reason: Clay tablets from Nebuchadnezzar's palace in Babylon record rations of oil given to "Ya'ukin, king of the land of Yahud" and to his sons, which shows that Jehoiachin was already being supplied by the court years earlier.

decisions.choice: an open ending: the line of David is still alive
alternatives: a note only that the king lived on in exile
decisions.reason: The book does not end with the burning of the temple but with David's heir alive, freed and honored. The LORD had promised David a lasting house (2 Samuel 7:12-16) and had kept "a lamp" for David in Jerusalem (1 Kings 11:36; 2 Kings 8:19). The writer does not say what this means, but the ending leaves room for hope. Jehoiachin's grandson Zerubbabel would later lead the return from exile (1 Chronicles 3:17-19; Ezra 3:2; Haggai 2:23).

decisions.choice: Jeremiah 52:34: "until the day of his death"
decisions.reason: Jeremiah 52:34 has the same sentence and adds "until the day of his death" before "all the days of his life".

decisions.choice: the king gave him (Balanced, Readable); what he needed for that day (Readable)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable make the king the subject instead of the passive "was given". Readable explains the allowance as what he needed each day.
